mods.name: quickbar
mods.description: A one-line launcher above the prompt: live context %, and one-click buttons for every claude-mods panel you have installed.

mods.name: toolbox
mods.description: Every tool Claude can use (built-in and MCP) in plain language, how often each was used, and suggestions tailored to the project you are in.

mods.name: usage-meter
mods.description: Plan-limit bars with burn rate and time-to-empty, session cost, cache hit ratio and tokens-per-turn sparkline.

mods.name: figures
mods.description: Draw diagrams, LaTeX math, and tool-result images inline in kitty-graphics terminals

mods.name: cache-refresher
mods.description: Shows when your prompt cache expires and what rebuilding it would cost. Optional auto-refresh, off by default, keeps it active while you are away and uses a little plan usage or API credit.

mods.name: wire
mods.description: The Wire Framework — AI-accelerated data platform delivery for the full lifecycle: requirements, design, development, testing, deployment, enablement

mods.name: flow-scenes
mods.description: Ambient scenes above the prompt that move with your agent's work: a fire, bubbles, surf, ski, rockets, a hot-air balloon and more, by day or night. /flow to control it.

mods.name: jev-pilot
mods.description: TypeSafe's Jev decides how Claude Code works on each prompt: the main conversation's reasoning effort (low to xhigh, raised to max mid-turn when tool calls keep failing), each subagent's model, whether to split the work across subagents, and the one skill the prompt needs. Brings in custom OpenRout…

mods.name: context-guard
mods.description: Warns before the context fills up; one click writes a work log, compacts, then resumes from the log. 上下文快满时提醒，一键写日志、压缩、从日志接着干。

mods.name: workflow-conductor
mods.description: Terminal UI for planning, running and understanding complex agent workflows inside Claude Code.

mods.name: cockpit
mods.description: Agent cockpit for Claude Code: live context, limits, cost, tools, files, tests and a guard for risky commands

mods.name: cc-mod-park
mods.description: /park a session you will come back to; a new session in the same folder offers it back with one click.

mods.name: mod-store
mods.description: /mods: browse, search and install community Claude Code mods from a pane, with what each one can access shown before you install

mods.name: action-pin
mods.description: After an edit that adds a GitHub Actions step pinned to a tag or a branch, names the commit SHA to write instead, from the GitHub API.

mods.name: ask-autopick
mods.description: Picks the recommended option of a question that waited unanswered for a set time, so a session you left does not stop. Off until you turn it on.

mods.name: bash-diet
mods.description: Shrinks each Bash result before the model reads it: per-command filters for git, test runners, linters, package managers, containers and file tools, the full output kept in a file.

mods.name: bg-tasks
mods.description: Shows the background shell tasks of the session on the status line or in the shared sidebar, with the oldest one's age, and stops one from the /bg-tasks pane.

mods.name: cache-warm
mods.description: Keeps the 1-hour prompt cache warm for a window you set, or with no end in every session under always, with one cache-shared fork per idle stretch and one keep-warm message after a resume, arms a window for you after a paid cold write, and shows the cache state, the cold price and this session's co…

mods.name: commit-cadence
mods.description: Names the uncommitted files to you at the end of each turn, and tells the model at the next prompt to commit each finished piece as it lands.

mods.name: config-parse
mods.description: Parses each JSON, YAML, TOML or .env file an Edit or Write touches, notes a parse error at once instead of at the next build, and says so again when a later edit fixes it.

mods.name: context-restore
mods.description: Hands a skill or command call the current text of its file when the file changed on disk after the session loaded it, and hands the model a rules file or the global CLAUDE.md that changed on disk.

mods.name: contract-watch
mods.description: After the model changes a function signature with Edit, adds the callers ripwire finds to the Edit's result, so the model fixes them before the build does.

mods.name: council
mods.description: Asks a council of models about a hard problem, when the model calls its tool or you run /council <question>: Claude models, and Gemini models when gemini-core has a key, answer in parallel, and the model of the session writes one verdict from their answers.

mods.name: dep-sentinel
mods.description: Checks each package the model installs against its registry and OSV.dev, and stops a missing, brand-new, look-alike, outdated or vulnerable one, naming the latest version.

mods.name: desk-notify
mods.description: Sends a desktop notification when a question or a plan waits for your answer, and when a turn ends or fails.

mods.name: diagram-render
mods.description: Renders the mermaid blocks of the model's replies with an installed mmdc after each turn and draws each picture under its reply.

mods.name: disk-janitor
mods.description: Measures the build artifacts of the repository, shows them on the status line from 5 GB, and deletes the ones you pick in the /disk-janitor pane; data directories are never listed.

mods.name: doc-drift-watch
mods.description: After each commit the model makes, adds the doc lines that commit made stale (file:line references, symbol names) to the commit's result, from ripwire doc-drift, and holds each finding open until the doc holds again.

mods.name: edit-loop
mods.description: Adds a note to the fifth edit of one file in one turn, so the model re-reads the code path and states the root cause instead of trying again.

mods.name: effort-auto
mods.description: Has a small model rate how hard each prompt is and runs that turn and its subagents at the matching effort, within the levels you allow, on the models whose prompt cache survives an effort change.

mods.name: env-sync
mods.description: After each commit the model makes, names the env variables its added lines read that .env.example lacks, with the file and line of each.

mods.name: error-poke
mods.description: Sends one continue prompt after a turn an API error killed, so the half-done work carries on instead of the session going idle, at most 99 times in a row by default.

mods.name: flaky-memory
mods.description: Remembers which tests failed on which code, and tells the model when a failing test has both passed and failed on the same code, so it runs the test again instead of changing code.

mods.name: gemini-advisor
mods.description: Gives the model a Gemini advisor tool it calls by itself: Gemini reads the whole conversation and the model's message and answers with a second opinion. Off until /gemini-advisor on; gemini-core holds the key, tier, model and thinking level.

mods.name: gemini-compact
mods.description: Moves compaction from Claude to Gemini: in summary mode Gemini summarizes the conversation and the newest messages stay verbatim, in prune mode every message stays and Gemini keeps, cuts or drops older tool calls. Off until /gemini-compact on; gemini-core holds the key, tier, model and thinking lev…

mods.name: gemini-core
mods.description: Keeps the Gemini keys and tier of every Gemini mod, and each mod's model and thinking level, in one place: adds $.gemini, which builds their Gemini requests, reads the answers and moves to the next key after a quota or key error, and picks a model from Google's list.

mods.name: gemini-plan-review
mods.description: Has Gemini review each plan before the approval dialog, from the plan and the conversation, and sends a plan with a blocking finding back to the model, at most twice. Off until /gemini-plan-review on; gemini-core holds the key, tier, model and thinking level.

mods.name: gemini-review
mods.description: Has Gemini review every git commit the model runs, from the staged diff and the conversation, and stops a commit with a blocking finding: a bug, data loss, a security hole or a committed secret. Off until /gemini-review on; gemini-core holds the key, tier, model and thinking level.

mods.name: git-commit
mods.description: Ships a commit skill and holds every Bash git commit to it: a commit the skill did not open, a blanket git add, a signature trailer, a secret, an ignored path, or a push or branch change nobody asked for is stopped before git runs.

mods.name: i18n-watch
mods.description: After an edit that calls translation keys, names the keys the JSON, Laravel PHP, YAML or gettext locale files lack, and the languages that lack them.

mods.name: idle-art
mods.description: Draws an ASCII animation above the prompt while the model works: matrix rain, fire, an aquarium, a cat, or a GIF of your own imported as a character clip for every project. Display only: nothing reaches the model.

mods.name: limit-watch
mods.description: Shows the subscription usage limits, the per-model weekly ones such as Fable's included, under the prompt or in the shared sidebar with a reset countdown and a projection, opens a /limit-watch pane, gives the model a tool that reads them, logs once when a limit passes 80% and 95%, and stops samplin…

mods.name: lockfile-sync
mods.description: After each commit the model makes, names the manifests whose dependencies it changed without their lockfile (npm, Composer, Cargo, Go, Python, Bundler, Dart, Mix).

mods.name: mcp-doctor
mods.description: Tells you when an MCP server failed to connect or dropped, with the engine's reason and a reconnect button, and when it is back; claude.ai connectors are left out.

mods.name: memory-save
mods.description: Loads MEMORY.md into the session and saves project learnings to it after every turn through a tool-less fork in the background, without blocking the stop.

mods.name: mod-doctor
mods.description: Names each installed plugin, of every marketplace, whose local clone already offers a newer version, with the claude plugin update command that closes the gap.

mods.name: orphan-server
mods.description: Lists the servers a Bash call of the model started in this repository and left listening on a port, with their age and session, and stops one with SIGTERM, then SIGKILL.

mods.name: output-flood
mods.description: Measures how much context each Bash command spent and tells the model, past a size limit, which narrower command would have answered the same question.

mods.name: pin-note
mods.description: Keeps the notes you pin with /pin-note for the whole session and sends them to the model again, word for word, after each compaction and /clear. Off until /pin-note on.

mods.name: plan-split
mods.description: Runs the main loop on one model in plan mode and on another in every other mode, switched by itself, set with /plan-split and off until /plan-split on.

mods.name: probe-runner
mods.description: For mod development: runs a live check of plugins in a fresh Claude Code session in tmux, types the steps one by one, collects the pane and the transcript, then deletes the temp directory, its transcripts and the inline store files.

mods.name: prompt-deck
mods.description: Learns the short prompts you send often in this project and draws them, with the ones you pin by hand, above the prompt; with the prompt box empty, a digit key sends one at once.

mods.name: prompt-offload
mods.description: Writes a prompt longer than the limit (2000 characters by default) to a temp file and sends the model its first 200 characters with the path, so one paste does not fill the context.

mods.name: prompt-time
mods.description: Draws the time under each of your messages and each text block of the model's replies, also for a resumed session whose transcript is 4 MiB or smaller. Display only: nothing reaches the model.

mods.name: sage-memory
mods.description: Keeps project and global memories in SQLite through a shared local daemon, hands the model the entries that match its file tool calls, prompts and subagent tasks, and saves new ones with a haiku consolidator after each main-loop turn.

mods.name: self-command
mods.description: For mod development: lets the model run a slash command in its own session, such as /reload-plugins after a plugin update, and read the output as the next prompt.

mods.name: session-watch
mods.description: Shows this session's state in the sidebar: context fill, token totals, cost, model and effort, the Claude Code version, the other sessions of this machine, and the git branch and status.

mods.name: shot-inline
mods.description: Draws each PNG or JPG the model saves or reads under its tool row: pixels in kitty and Ghostty, quadrant block cells in every other terminal.

mods.name: sidebar
mods.description: Opens one shared pane beside the transcript and draws the sections, lines and buttons every other mod writes into it through $.sidebar; each stream entry is stamped with its time and kept in a per-project log the next session takes back.

mods.name: slash-chain
mods.description: Runs slash commands joined with && one after another, waits for each command's turn, pane or dialog to end, and stops the chain at a command that failed or a turn that ended without an answer.

mods.name: sql-concat-watch
mods.description: After an edit that builds SQL by joining or interpolating strings, names each line, so the model passes the values as query parameters.

mods.name: storage-guard
mods.description: After an edit that keeps browser data in localStorage or sessionStorage, names each line, so the model stores the data in a cookie instead.

mods.name: subagent-ledger
mods.description: Shows each subagent of the session with its turns, time, model and tokens, the costliest first, yellow while it runs and green once it answered, and marks one that passed the token limit.

mods.name: task-poke
mods.description: Submits a continue prompt while the task list has unfinished tasks, at most 99 times in a row by default, and turns the task tools on for every model unless CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TODO_TOOLS is set.

mods.name: tool-coach
mods.description: Stops the model from repeating a tool call that just failed with the same input, until a file or command has changed something.

mods.name: ua-fallback
mods.description: After a curl or wget an automated-client filter answered 403 or 429, gives the model the browser User-Agent to retry with, and the two cases where it must not.

mods.name: open-todos
mods.description: Side pane listing unfinished and in-progress todos from all Claude Code sessions, grouped by project

mods.name: critical-decisions
mods.description: Shows you, above the prompt, the critical decisions the agent made without being asked: red to rethink, yellow to know, each with a rethink button. Works out of the box for any kind of project; /critical-areas auto lets the agent learn what is critical in yours.

mods.name: randsum
mods.description: RDN-conformant dice notation skills for Claude Code — roll dice, analyze probability, and create game specs for tabletop RPGs

mods.name: codex
mods.description: Run OpenAI Codex jobs as native background subagents (codex:luna, codex:sol, codex:astra, codex:terra): the native task list, SendMessage, TaskStop and finish notifications, with Codex approval requests as Claude Code dialogs.

mods.name: whats-agent-doing
mods.description: A small box above the prompt that always says what the agent is doing right now (reading, thinking, writing, running a tool, waiting for you) and expands to show what it has done.

mods.name: quote-reply
mods.description: Выделил текст предыдущего ответа — кнопка/комнанда вставляет его в черновик как цитату «предыдущий ответ», чтобы прокомментировать.

mods.name: agent-diet
mods.description: Runs search-only subagents (Explore by default) on Haiku instead of your main model; a model Claude asks for still wins, and /agent-diet picks the types and the model.

mods.name: answer-pane
mods.description: Explain, plan and ELI5 pages drawn natively in a side pane: diagrams in place, plan decisions as buttons, Respond fills the prompt box. No model calls.

mods.name: budget-guard
mods.description: Holds a prompt back once your 5-hour or weekly usage is at or over a limit you set (90% by default); sending it again goes through. No tokens spent.

mods.name: cache-clock
mods.description: Shows how long the prompt cache stays warm, and when it expires, exactly how many tokens your next message will re-send uncached. No tokens spent.

mods.name: cmd-diet
mods.description: Adds quiet flags to noisy shell commands before they run (git status, pytest, cargo, npm install, mvn, curl, wget, docker pull), so Claude reads short output from the start; errors, failures and warnings stay in full.

mods.name: collision-guard
mods.description: Asks before Claude edits a file another chat on this machine changed in the last 30 minutes. Each chat keeps its own small ledger; no model calls, no network.

mods.name: compact-keeper
mods.description: After a compaction, adds one message with exact facts from before it: your latest prompt in full, up to 4 earlier ones, the files edited, the todo list and the last failed shell command. At most 4,000 characters. No model calls.

mods.name: context-xray
mods.description: A pane with the exact breakdown of what fills Claude's context: system prompt, tools, memory files, skills, messages, and which tools load on every request.

mods.name: gh-account
mods.description: Runs each git push, pull, fetch, clone and gh command as the logged-in GitHub account that owns or belongs to the repository's owner, so Claude stops switching gh accounts and retrying failed pushes.

mods.name: kit-updates
mods.description: Tells you when a newer version of an installed claude-pro-kit mod is out, and /kit-update installs it along with any new mods you never had. One small download per session, no tokens spent.

mods.name: loop-guard
mods.description: Holds back a shell command once when the exact same command already failed twice in a row, and tells Claude to change approach; retrying it still goes through.

mods.name: nudge
mods.description: /nudge <goal> applies behavioral design to a product or flow: diagnose why users don't act, design interventions that remove barriers, ranked hypotheses to test, and an ethics check on every answer. Its guide reaches Claude only when you run /nudge.

mods.name: output-diet
mods.description: Trims long shell output, Grep results and subagent reports before Claude reads them (head, tail and error lines kept); the untrimmed text is saved to a file Claude can open.

mods.name: peek
mods.description: Typing "status" while background shells or subagents run opens a pane with each task's exact elapsed time, the tail of its output and any percent it printed, instead of sending the prompt to Claude. /peek opens it too. No tokens spent.

mods.name: pro-hud
mods.description: Desktop heads-up display for the Pro plan: exact 5h/7d usage gauges, context gauge, turn receipts, usage in the spinner and compact tool cards. No estimates, no tokens spent.

mods.name: prompt-polish
mods.description: An Improve button above the prompt (and /polish) rewrites your draft with Opus at low effort (/polish model picks another) using the prompt-master rules (MIT, nidhinjs/prompt-master); Undo puts the original back. Each press is one model call; its exact tokens are shown.

mods.name: read-cap
mods.description: Stops Claude reading a file over 1,000 lines whole (with Read, cat or Get-Content) and gives it an outline tool (definitions with line numbers) so it reads only the range it needs. A retry still reads it whole.

mods.name: reread-guard
mods.description: Stops Claude re-reading a file it already read in this conversation, with Read or a plain cat, sed -n, head, tail or Get-Content, when the file has not changed since; a deliberate second attempt still goes through.

mods.name: session-receipt
mods.description: /receipt opens a pane with the exact tokens every turn of the session spent (uncached, cached, output, subagents) and the costliest turns. No tokens spent.

mods.name: skill-diet
mods.description: Lists skills you have not used lately in this project by name only, so their descriptions stop riding along on every request; the Skill tool and /name still load any of them. No model calls.

mods.name: tool-diet
mods.description: Moves tools you have not used lately behind ToolSearch, so their descriptions stop riding along on every request; core tools and anything you used in your last five sessions stay loaded.

mods.name: turn-budget
mods.description: When one turn uses more than +5 session points or 500,000 uncached input tokens, writes a handoff from exact session data and copies it for a new session; the old session is never cleared. No model calls.

mods.name: write-guard
mods.description: Steers Claude to Edit instead of rewriting an existing file in full with Write: the first rewrite in a conversation goes through with a one-line note, a later one is held back once; a deliberate retry still goes through.

mods.name: agent-router
mods.description: Choose a model and effort for five agent roles and for agent team teammates with /agent-models, and inspect routing and usage. Requires Claude Code Mod function hooks enabled.

mods.name: keepalive
mods.description: A prompt cache bar for every conversation, subagent and teammate, a dashboard with /keepalive, per-conversation cache TTLs, and upkeep that keeps an idle cache warm or compacts it before it expires. Requires Claude Code Mod function hooks enabled.

mods.name: ci-light
mods.description: Know when main is broken before you build on it: a red row above the prompt says how long your repo's default branch has been failing CI and how many pushes landed on top, and the agent is told too.

mods.name: leaks
mods.description: Find where your Claude Code week went and fix it: /leaks ranks the avoidable spend in your transcripts with one-press fixes, and a strip above the prompt flags a leak while it happens.

mods.name: fanyi
mods.description: Write to Claude Code in your own language while Claude works in English: prompts are translated to English, and each reply gets a streamed translation underneath.

mods.name: jev-blindspot-band
mods.description: A one-glance summary of jev-blindspot in the band above the prompt: the blind spot count, the deeper question, and the top findings for the prompt you just sent.

mods.name: cli-dispatch
mods.description: Delegate tasks to the right worker CLI — multi-backend delegation hub. Backends: DeepSeek-powered Claude Code (claude-ds), Antigravity / Gemini (agy, ag-agent), OpenAI Codex CLI (codex, cx-agent), OpenCode via OpenRouter (opencode, oc-agent), GitHub Copilot CLI (copilot, cp-agent), and a local Olla…

mods.name: sn
mods.description: ServiceNow CLI wrapper — table CRUD, change management, CMDB, attachments, service catalog, import sets, CI reconciliation, CICD, aggregates, and schema discovery

mods.name: redact
mods.description: Masks credential-shaped strings in a Read tool result before the model reads it.

mods.name: agents-view
mods.description: A pane listing this session's subagents (Agent tool and workflow agents) with their status; select one to see its prompt, text, tool calls and results.

mods.name: file-view
mods.description: Click a file path under a Read, Edit or Write row to show that file's contents, or the picture of a PNG, JPEG or SVG, in a pane beside the transcript, or let the model open one with the open_file tool.

mods.name: issue-view
mods.description: A pane listing the project root repository's open issues with titles; click one to open it in the browser.

mods.name: pr-view
mods.description: A pane listing the project root repository's open pull requests with titles; click one to open it in the browser.

mods.name: rich-terminal
mods.description: Mermaid diagrams drawn inside Claude Code replies, and a truecolor status line under the prompt with a Token Weather forecast of the context window.

mods.name: agentpane
mods.description: A side pane for Claude Code that lists the subagents a session runs, what each is doing and what it costs in tokens, with each one's conversation a click away.

mods.name: awsh
mods.description: awsh for Claude Code: an `aw` subagent type whose model steps are answered by a session on the local awsh harness daemon, so any harness and any backend the daemon can drive runs as a native Claude Code subagent, streamed live. Also carries the Aither World skills, the `aither` output style, MCP se…

mods.name: awcompact
mods.description: Compacts a long tool result through the AitherOS decision door before the model reads it: per LINE SHAPE, learned from outcomes, never dropping a traceback or a summary line.

mods.name: budget-guard
mods.description: Stops a session before it runs past a budget. Three figures are guarded, each with a limit you set: the session cost in dollars, the 5-hour plan window and the 7-day plan window. It says nothing until a figure nears its limit, then pins a status line and warns once; past the limit it refuses tool c…

mods.name: context-lens
mods.description: A live /context: a pinned line under the prompt with the window fill and the growth per turn, and /context-lens for a pane with the per-category bars and how many turns are left before auto-compaction.

mods.name: quota-meter
mods.description: Shows the subscription plan limits - the 5-hour window, the 7-day window and a gateway spend limit - as a pinned status line under the prompt, with a reset countdown and a projection of when you would hit 100% at the pace of the last few samples. /quota opens a pane with a bar, the reset clock time…

mods.name: token-ledger
mods.description: A per-turn cost and token ledger: a pinned status line with the session cost, the last turn's tokens and the cache hit ratio, and /ledger for a table of the recent turns with their model, tokens, cache reads and writes, duration and cost.

mods.name: turntype
mods.description: A typing challenge while Claude works: press 1 in an empty prompt, or run /type.

mods.name: agent-watch
mods.description: Subagents at a glance: a card per agent with its mascot, step and tokens, a band above the prompt, a toast when one stalls, and a summary naming the heaviest agent when they finish

mods.name: allowlist-coach
mods.description: Counts permission dialogs per rule and, after repeated approvals, offers to add the rule to permissions.allow, asking before it writes

mods.name: launchpad
mods.description: A menu of one-click actions under the header, above the prompt or in a pane, and a control panel from ◆ pad: model and effort in one click, this collection's mods, the shortcuts. Pick and order up to 8 with /pad configuration

mods.name: limits-meter
mods.description: Plan limits, cache clock and context above the prompt: model and effort, 5-hour and weekly windows with reset times, a countdown of the prompt cache with an opt-in keep-warm that spends plan, context split by group (system, MCP, messages), tokens per turn, and a toast on a costly model switch near…

mods.name: plain-view
mods.description: A quiet transcript: tool rows step aside and the agent's plan shows as a card above the prompt, with the current step, progress bars and a summary when the turn ends

mods.name: test-hud
mods.description: Test runs at a glance: passing over total on the hint line under the prompt, colored by the result, a sparkline of failures across runs, the failing tests grouped by file, and toasts when the suite turns green or a test turns flaky

mods.name: simple-english
mods.description: Apply technical and house-style writing rules to writes, edits, git commit messages, and replies. Needs Claude Code 2.1.296 or later.

mods.name: desk-look
mods.description: Claude Code mod that redraws the terminal transcript to look like the Code tab of the Claude desktop app: prompt bubbles, markdown tables, mermaid diagrams, folded tool calls, agent cards, plan cards in the transcript, a progress band of the current step and what runs now, GitHub/GitLab PR bar, dif…

mods.name: desk-plan
mods.description: Claude Code mod that asks for plan approval (ExitPlanMode) in a card above the prompt instead of the full-screen engine dialog, with the plan open in desk-look's preview pane: 1 approves, 2 views the plan, type what to change or comment on plan lines in the pane (c, then 3) to send it back, 9 for t…

mods.name: desk-review
mods.description: Claude Code mod with a /desk-review:simplify-review skill (/simplify, then /code-review medium) whose report opens in a side pane: each fixed, skipped, found or dismissed item with its reason, its diff or current source unfolding in place, and the file opened in desk-look's diff pane. Needs desk-lo…

mods.name: flowpane
mods.description: A live workflow pane: replaces the default Workflow progress list with a phase-by-phase graph or a timeline beside the transcript, showing each agent's state, timing, live token spend, tool calls, what it is saying, and prompt.

mods.name: nerviz-cockpit
mods.description: Draws what ArchHook already decides: the open skill phase and its write territory above the prompt, /nerviz-doctor in a pane, and a guard refusal held behind two buttons.

mods.name: nerviz-config
mods.description: A pane over `ArchHook.jar config`: the settings a project owns in its own .claude/, in the nerviz identity, changed only through `config set` and `config unset` after a dialog.

mods.name: context-card
mods.description: Context window breakdown and plan usage, in the band above the prompt.

mods.name: pr-pane
mods.description: Sessions of this project, their worktrees and PRs, with check-ins, in a side pane.

mods.name: commonplace
mods.description: A knowledge vault Claude reads and keeps for any folder of notes: graph-indexed vault tools, private domains that stay sealed, connections to what you already wrote surfaced under answers, and [[note]] links in replies that are checked against the vault.

mods.name: cache-maxxer
mods.description: Shows the prompt cache's countdown and hit rate above the input box, explains every cache break and cache expiry, and can keep the cache warm to cut Claude Code cost

mods.name: cache-keep-warm
mods.description: Shows how long your session's prompt cache stays warm, and can keep it warm in the background while you are away

mods.name: glanceflow

mods.name: jr-awake
mods.description: Keeps the Mac awake while Claude works, shared by every session on the machine, and warns before the next sleep.

mods.name: jr-badge
mods.description: A coloured project badge and its branch, on the right above the prompt, so you always know which window you are typing in. Hidden until you type /jr-badge. A `badge: LABEL #hex` line in CLAUDE.md sets your own.

mods.name: jr-cache-clock
mods.description: A toast 30 seconds before the prompt cache goes cold, and on /jr-cache-clock a quiet countdown above the prompt: how long the cache stays warm after Claude's last reply, going green to red, and the last cache hit rate.

mods.name: jr-context
mods.description: The context window in one quiet row above the prompt: a mini bar coloured by category, the fill and the window, turning into an alert when compaction is near. /jr-context hides or shows it, /jr-context details opens the full bar with its legend.

mods.name: jr-decisions
mods.description: A decision journal per project: /jr-decisions <decision> or a prompt starting with "decision:" records one, /jr-decisions lists them, /jr-decisions export writes docs/decisions.md.

mods.name: jr-deploy-guard
mods.description: Production deploys and pushes to main always come to you for confirmation, even when your rules allow them. Optional: no deploys on Friday.

mods.name: jr-deslop
mods.description: Flags AI-writing tells (em dashes, "delve", "not X, but Y", stock openers...) in the prose files Claude writes. A toast after each file, /jr-deslop for the list. Never rewrites anything.

mods.name: jr-dictation
mods.description: Fixes what dictation mishears ("cloud code" → Claude Code) before Claude reads your prompt, and shows each fix in your prompt row: red struck, green added.

mods.name: jr-done-check
mods.description: Flags replies that claim something was tested or verified when nothing was run in the turn to check it: a warning under the message and a toast.

mods.name: jr-done-ping
mods.description: A notification, and a sound on macOS, when a long turn finishes: work in another window and come back when Claude is done. Names the project and how long it took.

mods.name: jr-draft
mods.description: /jr-draft: a scratch pane to write your next prompt while Claude works, kept per project, sent to the prompt box when you are ready.

mods.name: jr-explain
mods.description: Every shell command Claude asks permission for comes with a plain-English explanation and a risk level: low, medium or high.

mods.name: jr-fleet
mods.description: Every Claude Code session on this machine at a glance: which ones are working and which ones wait for you, in a band above the prompt (/jr-fleet hides or shows it) and in /jr-fleet details.

mods.name: jr-goal
mods.description: A goal per project with steps you tick off, shown above the prompt with a progress gauge. /jr-goal to set it.

mods.name: jr-image-guard
mods.description: Keeps oversized images out of the conversation: an image over 7800 px is read through a resized copy, and browser viewports over the limit are refused.

mods.name: jr-limits
mods.description: Plan limits in one quiet row above the prompt: the 5-hour and 7-day fill and when the fullest resets, an alert from 80 %, a toast at 80 % and 95 %. /jr-limits hides or shows it, /jr-limits details opens the gauges.

mods.name: jr-mod-audit
mods.description: /jr-mod-audit owner/repo: clones a mod, runs the official validator on each plugin in it, reads its source, and shows what it can reach with a green, amber or red verdict before you install it.

mods.name: jr-mods
mods.description: /jr-mods: every installed plugin and mod in one list. Space ticks or unticks, Enter applies all the changes at once. /jr-mods welcome explains what each jr mod shows.

mods.name: jr-next-cost
mods.description: What the next prompt costs before you send it, on /jr-next-cost: the context it resends at the current model's price, read from a warm cache or written to a cold one, at API rates.

mods.name: jr-no-ai-trailer
mods.description: Stops commits and pull requests that carry an AI co-author line or a 'Generated with' footer, so your history stays yours.

mods.name: jr-no-promise
mods.description: When a reply ends by announcing work ("I'll…", "Let me…", "je vais…") and no tool ran in the turn, Claude is sent back once to actually do it.

mods.name: jr-nudges
mods.description: At the end of a turn, one toast when the code Claude wrote added debug statements (console.log, print, debugger) or TODO/FIXME/HACK lines.

mods.name: jr-outage
mods.description: Is it them or is it me? The status of Claude, GitHub, npm and Vercel, checked every 10 minutes: /jr-outage shows them all, a band and a toast appear only when one is degraded.

mods.name: jr-pkg-guard
mods.description: Checks every package install against its registry first: names that do not exist (hallucinated or typosquatted) are refused, very new packages are held back or flagged, install scripts are flagged.

mods.name: jr-polish
mods.description: /jr-polish <rough prompt>: a small fast model rewrites it into a clear, structured prompt in the same language and puts it in your prompt box to edit and send.

mods.name: jr-post
mods.description: /jr-post: a short "what I built today" post drafted from this session, shown in a pane and copied to your clipboard.

mods.name: jr-quota
mods.description: Balances of the other paid APIs you use (OpenRouter, Firecrawl, DeepSeek), checked every 10 minutes: /jr-quota details shows them all, /jr-quota hides or shows the band; a band and a toast appear only when one runs low.

mods.name: jr-read-cap
mods.description: Stops Claude from reading a long file whole: a Read of a file over 1,000 lines without a range is refused with a hint to grep first and read only the lines it needs. Saves context and tokens.

mods.name: jr-record
mods.description: Recording mode for demos and screen shares: /jr-record masks emails, money amounts, keys, phone numbers and IPs on screen. Claude still reads the real text.

mods.name: jr-redact
mods.description: Replaces API keys, tokens, private keys and database passwords in tool results with placeholders before Claude reads them. Emails and IPs too, if you ask.

mods.name: jr-scope
mods.description: Warns when a turn writes sensitive files nobody asked for (lockfiles, manifests, CI, .env, migrations, infra) or too many files at once.

mods.name: jr-stripemrr
mods.description: Your Stripe MRR and today's revenue above the prompt, refreshed every 15 minutes; /jr-stripemrr adds the last 30 days as a sparkline.

mods.name: jr-sysinfo
mods.description: Disk, RAM, CPU and swap in one quiet row above the prompt, refreshed every 5 minutes by a local script on macOS, Linux and Windows. No model call, no tokens.

mods.name: jr-time
mods.description: Billable time per project: every minute of a session sorted into categories, a ratio per category, an hourly rate, and an amount. /jr-time to adjust, export to CSV or Markdown.

mods.name: jr-todo
mods.description: /jr-todo <task>: capture a task instantly, with no model call, to TODO.md, Todoist, Linear, Notion, a GitHub issue, Things, Apple Reminders, or your own command.

mods.name: jr-uptime
mods.description: Pings your sites every 2 minutes; a red band above the prompt the moment one goes down, and /jr-uptime with latency sparklines and the last incident.

mods.name: jr-vinci
mods.description: An opt-in sparring partner: after each answer, one line above the prompt with the sharpest challenge to what was just decided. /jr-vinci on, off, or the history.

mods.name: jr-visitors
mods.description: Live visitors from PostHog above the prompt (last 5 minutes and today), refreshed every 2 minutes; /jr-visitors adds today's top pages.

mods.name: sidecar
mods.description: A side pane with buttons for Claude's options and questions, a session summary, a work diagram, and a log of the conversation

mods.name: tdd-mod
mods.description: Blocks file writes that break Red-Green-Refactor on coding tasks (port of probity's enforceTdd).

mods.name: clawd-stage
mods.description: Clawd lives in a band above the prompt and plays 200 animations, every second one with full-width scenery

mods.name: crab-band
mods.description: Your Claude usage limits in the status line, and a band above the prompt with a row for the main session (task list, progress gauge, model, context, time) and one per running subagent, each led by a Clawd-style pixel crab that dances in an outfit chosen by model and effort; and /agents-info, a plai…

mods.name: gaia
mods.description: GAIA — Generative AI Interface for Agents. Security-first multi-agent orchestration for Claude Code and OpenCode: reads run free, state changes need approval, irreversible ops blocked.

mods.name: missioncache
mods.description: Project memory that survives compaction. The plan, decisions, gotchas and next steps live in markdown files and reload with one command. One lead session watches the rest.

mods.name: rtl-terminal
mods.description: Right-to-left layout for Arabic, Hebrew, Persian, Urdu and every RTL language in the Claude Code terminal

mods.name: cc-skins
mods.description: Skins, a usage bar and quick controls for Claude Code: 40 looks (Catppuccin, Tokyo Night, Dracula, Nord and more) plus your own, model and effort, context and limits, cost, alerts and a usage dashboard.

mods.name: ricky-pixel-mod
mods.description: Ricky, a pixel-art cat companion for Claude Code: an animated night-sky pane with a task / subagent / activity / files board, a cat in the band above the prompt, and a purple-gold spinner

mods.name: clocks-band
mods.description: A band above the prompt showing every Bash command, MCP call and subagent that has run for a while, with elapsed time against its limit.

mods.name: local-answer-router
mods.description: Answers trivial questions (what branch, what changed, did the last test pass) from git and the last test run on your machine, with no model tokens.

mods.name: subagent-meter
mods.description: A live status line showing how much of your session's tokens go to subagents, and which agent type uses the most.

mods.name: android-device-console
mods.description: Live Android device console: UI-state toggles, Doze and standby controls, WorkManager job runner, and the device state in the system prompt.

mods.name: android-logcat
mods.description: Bounds the model's adb logcat calls, redacts secrets from adb output, keeps a pid-scoped logcat buffer with a grep tool and a /logcat pane.

mods.name: android-screen
mods.description: Lets Claude see and drive an Android device: screenshots, a compact view hierarchy with tap points, input and app control, plus a live device mirror pane.

mods.name: effort-router
mods.description: Picks low/medium/high/xhigh effort per prompt for Opus/Sonnet/Haiku 5.5+ and Fable/Mythos 5.1+ by how uncertain and costly the work is, raising it mid-turn when a turn runs long; a typed /effort applies at once

mods.name: git-nudge
mods.description: Notices when the session's git repository falls behind its upstream, leaves work behind (uncommitted changes, stashes, a half-done rebase, a stale index.lock) or keeps branches whose upstream is gone; offers a safe fast-forward and a cleanup of merged branches. Calls no model.

mods.name: quality-router
mods.description: Quality-first routing: picks main-loop effort (medium to max) per request, assigns model and effort to subagents by kind and weight, checks Workflow agent() staffing, records judgments locally; the top-model guard is opt-in

mods.name: superpowers-progress
mods.description: Shows a Superpowers run in a pane beside the chat: the plan's title, where the workflow is (design, plan, build, finish), the current task and its step (implement, review, fix round), a progress bar, and the controller's rulings. Reads the plan and the SDD ledger; calls no model.

mods.name: fresh
mods.description: Start clean after a merged PR: on the default branch, level with the remote, with the branches and worktrees that already landed gone. Installs or updates Festival's camp CLI when needed.

mods.name: rea-casebook
mods.description: A live casebook of the Evidence rea gives the agent while it reverse engineers a binary: Ghidra's cold start, findings that must cite real evidence_id values, a session journal and Markdown or artifact exports.

mods.name: blast-radius
mods.description: Stops a command that could lose your work before it runs: deleting files (rm -rf), throwing away unsaved changes or saved versions (git reset, checkout, clean, branch -D), overwriting the shared copy (force push), writing over files, changing or dropping a database, or removing what docker, terrafo…

mods.name: cache-tax
mods.description: Keeps the chat ready (the one-hour prompt cache) during breaks, so your next message does not make Claude read the whole chat again at full price. After a long break or a model change it holds your message on a card with the estimated cost. Keeping the chat ready sends small requests that cost toke…

mods.name: checkpoint
mods.description: Quietly saves a restore point before each turn's first file change; /checkpoints lists the turns and undoes one after you confirm

mods.name: done-ping
mods.description: A notification when a long turn (your message and its answer) finishes or Claude waits on you (a permission or a question): the desktop app's own notification where it can, else a macOS banner with the project, what happened and a short detail

mods.name: effort-router
mods.description: Shows how hard Claude thought on each turn (effort) and which model answered; can send a simple message at a lower thinking level

mods.name: filetree
mods.description: A file tree of what Claude touches: what it is doing now, the files it touched this turn, and which changes are not saved yet (git status)

mods.name: handoff
mods.description: Saves working notes before the chat is summarized to free its memory (compact) and offers them back after; when the memory is nearly full it asks once: summarize now or hand off to a fresh chat

mods.name: hud-pro
mods.description: One quiet line above your message box, in the terminal and the desktop app: how much of the 5-hour and weekly usage allowance is used and when it refills, how full the chat's memory is, and the chat's ≈cost; /hud full shows the details

mods.name: modz
mods.description: The MODZ hub: opens on the right when a session starts; agents, files, plan, tests, checkpoints, replay, usage, look and every mod, one click away

mods.name: plan-steps
mods.description: Shows the plan's steps when there is one (task list, approved plan or plan file): the /steps panel and a quiet line under the chat; keeps an open plan when the chat is cleared (/clear) or summarized (compact), and asks before an answer leaves steps open

mods.name: pr-card
mods.description: When Claude opens a change request (pull request) on GitHub, shows a card under it in the chat: whether its automatic checks pass, whether a reviewer approved it, whether it can be merged, and which files it changes. It keeps the card up to date through the GitHub tool (gh).

mods.name: projects
mods.description: Every project in one place: percent done, plans, where it stopped, usage (tokens) and helper agents; /projects and a full-screen board

mods.name: reflect-mod
mods.description: claude-reflect as a Claude Code mod: notices when you correct Claude (a quick word check in Turkish and English, then one small model check) and offers, on a card above your message box, to save the correction as a lasting rule in the instructions file you choose (CLAUDE.md); /mine finds what keeps…

mods.name: replay-theater
mods.description: Replay Theater: step through the file edits of the last turn, or of any earlier turn and past session read from the saved conversations, with what each step does, the plan step it served and the changed lines in color.

mods.name: savvy-progress
mods.description: A progress band above the prompt and the Agents pane: each subagent gets a crab and a card with its status, progress, cost and time, a timeline and a quiet-agent warning. Progress comes only from what was observed.

mods.name: secret-guard
mods.description: Catches secret keys (passwords, API keys, tokens) before they are written into a file or saved in a version, and stops the secrets file (.env) from being saved with your work. A card shows each key half-hidden and asks you to move it to the secrets file, allow it once, or cancel. Keys you paste int…

mods.name: session-budget
mods.description: A spending cap for one chat (a share of the 5-hour usage allowance, or dollars): a note at 80%, and at 100% it asks Continue anyway or Stop before your next message goes

mods.name: skins
mods.description: Looks (skins) for Claude Code's chat: styled tool rows, reply lines and busy words, and living ASCII scenes above your message box. /skin swaps them live.

mods.name: terminal-browser
mods.description: A browser that runs in the terminal, inside Claude Code: preview sites and HTML documents, and let the agent drive the built-in browser. Terminal only; it draws nothing on the desktop.

mods.name: test-badge
mods.description: After Claude changes your code, runs the project's tests and its style-rule check (lint) on their own and shows the result in one line (tests 41/42 · style rules: 2 errors · 4s ago), with a panel that lists each failing test and where it is. It also follows the automatic checks GitHub runs on your…

mods.name: wrapped
mods.description: Your year with Claude Code as a story and a video, from your own transcripts: persona, which agents did the work, month by month. /wrapped; Hide names masks project and file names before you share. Uses no model tokens.

mods.name: kit-gallery
mods.description: Visual QA for the MODZ kit: /kit-gallery opens a pane drawing every kit component in several states

mods.name: usage-bars
mods.description: Your Claude Code 5-hour and 7-day usage limits as animated bars under the prompt: percent, reset countdown, pace mark, projection, per-answer delta, styles (Pac-Man, beer, tank, battery, hourglass)

mods.name: pstack
mods.description: poteto's rigorous engineering skills (poteto-mode, how/why, architect, verification), ported from Cursor and kept in sync with upstream

mods.name: clawd-tales
mods.description: A pixel Clawd acts out every tool call above the prompt; helpers wander in by model color. Terminal-first, no model calls.

mods.name: ultrapowers
mods.description: The client for ultrapowers: /ultrapowers <plan-path> commits an approved plan and runs on an exe.dev fleet you provision — a disposable sandbox runs the plan as a pool of tasks, a pool of builders, the plan's own probes and checks as the proof, and opens its own PR. No local engine.

mods.name: mods-manager
mods.description: Painel para ver, ligar, desligar, instalar e agrupar em perfis os seus mods e plugins.

mods.name: clawd
mods.description: Clawd, the Claude mascot, thinks, types, runs and celebrates beside the thinking line, a little differently each turn

mods.name: agent-map
mods.description: Windows only. A Claude Code mod: one pane, opened with /map, that draws every Claude session on this machine as a tree of who started whom, with controls to peek, open, message, flag, stop, close, configure and launch sessions. Optional: ChatGPT worker jobs through a chatgpt-run launcher, and ticke…

mods.name: am-context-bar
mods.description: A context card above the prompt with a collapsed and an expanded view: zone-coloured token count (dumb zone from 50% or 250k tokens, compact or clear from 70% or 400k), context bar with the dumb zone, where to compact or clear and auto-compact marked, breakdown by category, limits, model, thinking,…

mods.name: micro-compaction
mods.description: Adds `/compact micro`: elides Read results and strips thinking, keeping the conversation structure

mods.name: lexi
mods.description: Test-first workflow for coding agents, without the spec ceremony. A PreToolUse hook keeps source edits behind a mirror test and protects existing assertions; the flow drives one vertical slice at a time, red to green, through the project's own gate. Ships its own tdd and grill skills; includes the…

mods.name: cc-strategic-compaction
mods.description: Compacts the conversation when the rules say the moment is right, judged against the conversation itself at the end of a turn.

mods.name: clawd-hud-spike
mods.description: Spike da HUD RPG: sondas no app real para os itens A VALIDAR (sem gastar tokens)

mods.name: hero-journey
mods.description: HUD de RPG aconchegante para o Claude Code, com os caranguejos Clawd multiclasse (pt-BR e English)

mods.name: docket
mods.description: Keeps Claude's open questions, confirmations and hand-offs in numbered lists in a pane beside the chat, answerable by label or by button

mods.name: usagi-code
mods.description: Usagi or Chiikawa acts out what Claude is doing in a pane above the prompt, with the order, subagents and progress beside it. Ported from clockendbader/mascot-studio (MIT).

mods.name: noctis
mods.description: Runs long Claude Code jobs overnight within your usage limits: pauses just before the 5-hour or weekly limit, resumes the same session after the reset (or relaunches it days later) and works through a list of jobs you hand it with /noctis:start <file>. Also runs in Codex CLI, Antigravity CLI, Droid…

mods.name: sub-human
mods.description: Work together from separate Claude Code sessions, on one machine or over a link: one command joins a shared room, @room posts your exact words, Claudes message each other natively, a room plan is edited in plan mode with versions, tasks are shared, and sign-off opens in each person's plan view.

mods.name: change-journal
mods.description: A live HTML page that shows every change Claude makes, with diffs, the reason for each edit, checks, and before/after behavior flows.

mods.name: decision-lens
mods.description: See the decisions Claude made in each turn, why it made them, and steer future turns with keep and avoid rules.

mods.name: grill
mods.description: While Claude works on your task, a sharp partner asks the questions that change the result. Answers reach Claude mid-turn. Brainstorm and side chat modes too.

mods.name: little-harvest
mods.description: Every file that changes becomes a crop: Claude's edits and yours grow a farm in its own pane, tests bring sun or storms, and passing turns fill the barn.

mods.name: looks
mods.description: Make Claude Code look the way you like: four themes (Retro CRT, Punk, Synthwave, Zen paper) switched with /theme, tidier tool calls, and optional one-line tool rows and replies centered at a reading width.

mods.name: night-feast
mods.description: A vampire feeds on every tool call Claude finishes while the moon tracks how full the context window is. Between meals it stalks, swoops, and lies in wait. Dawn means it is time to compact.

mods.name: pocket-familiar
mods.description: A fox spirit that lives on your work: passing tests feed it, finished turns cheer it, it plays while you are quiet, and it grows up to nine tails.

mods.name: samurai-dojo
mods.description: A Claude samurai cuts down a Codex, Gemini, or ChatGPT foe for every tool call, and meditates, trains, and duels between them through four seasons.

mods.name: scope-guard
mods.description: Notices when Claude drifts outside your request. Clear drift waits for your answer in a question dialog; milder drift is flagged above the prompt with a pull-back key.

mods.name: slayer-corps
mods.description: Tanjiro, Nezuko, Zenitsu, and Inosuke take turns against demons up to Muzan as you and Claude work, and spar between strikes. The story continues every session.

mods.name: unslop
mods.description: Finds AI slop in Claude's changes (dashes, comment blocks, comments that repeat the code, tests that assert nothing, filler phrases) and tells Claude to remove it. Shows what was unslopped.

mods.name: savvy-progress-th
mods.description: แถบ progress ภาษาไทย: เวลาที่ใช้, จำนวน tool, token และค่าใช้จ่ายเป็นบาท

mods.name: you-should-know-th
mods.description: เตือนทิปเด็ดภาษาไทยตามสิ่งที่คุณกำลังทำ เช่น ใช้ @ mention ไฟล์, ใช้ Plan Mode, context ใกล้เต็ม

mods.name: filetree-th
mods.description: แผงด้านข้างแสดงไฟล์ที่ Claude อ่าน แก้ไข สร้าง หรือลบ จัดกลุ่มตามโฟลเดอร์ พร้อมไอคอนไทย

mods.name: cache-tax-th
mods.description: ดูว่าโดนชาร์จค่า Prompt Cache เท่าไหร่ คิดเป็นบาท พร้อม Hit Rate และคำแนะนำ

mods.name: blast-radius-th
mods.description: ก่อน Claude แก้ไฟล์ บอกว่ามีไฟล์ไหน import ไฟล์นั้นอยู่บ้าง พร้อมระดับความเสี่ยง (ใช้ git grep)

mods.name: reflect-th
mods.description: ทบทวนงานแบบ Retrospective: สรุปว่า Claude ใช้ tool อะไร สำเร็จ/ล้มเหลวเท่าไหร่ พร้อมคำแนะนำและบันทึกเป็นไฟล์

mods.name: terminal-browser-th
mods.description: เปิดเว็บจาก Claude Code: ให้ Claude สรุปเว็บเป็นไทย, ดูข้อความดิบ, เว็บโปรด, ค้นหา และประวัติ

mods.name: replay-theater-th
mods.description: บันทึกทุกอย่างที่ Claude ทำเป็นฉากหนัง ดูย้อนหลัง เล่นทีละฉากในแผง และส่งออกเป็น HTML

mods.name: file-manager-th
mods.description: ตัวจัดการไฟล์ภาษาไทยด้วยคำสั่ง /fm: ดู สร้าง ย้าย ก็อป ค้นหา ถังขยะกู้คืนได้ สำรองไฟล์ ไฟล์โปรด

mods.name: mermaid-inline-th
mods.description: วาดบล็อก mermaid ในคำตอบของ Claude เป็นภาพกล่องและลูกศรสีตรงตำแหน่งเดิม รองรับ flowchart, sequenceDiagram, pie และตัวอักษรไทย

mods.name: time-blame-th
mods.description: งานช้าเพราะอะไร: แบ่งเวลาทุกรอบเป็น Claude คิด, tool รันจริง, subagent, รอคุณกดอนุญาต และอื่นๆ พร้อม /blame ใบสรุปทั้ง session

mods.name: workface-th
mods.description: สมุดโน้ตงานที่รอดทุกการ compact: Claude จดเป้าหมาย การตัดสินใจ กับดัก งานค้างเองผ่าน tool เก็บเป็นไฟล์ แนบกลับหลัง compact และข้าม session

mods.name: sweet-alert-th
mods.description: Alert สวยๆ แบบ SweetAlert ใน Claude Code: dialog กลางจอมีปุ่มกด, ถามยืนยัน, ช่องกรอกข้อมูล, toast และคิว alert

mods.name: flex-message-th
mods.description: สร้าง LINE Flex Message จากคำสั่งภาษาไทย 6 แบบ ดูตัวอย่างในแผง และได้ JSON พร้อมส่ง LINE Messaging API

mods.name: nokia-games-th
mods.description: เกมงูและ Tetris จอเขียวแบบ Nokia 3310 เล่นในแผงข้าง Claude Code ด้วยปุ่ม w a s d พร้อม High Score

mods.name: promptpay-qr-th
mods.description: สร้าง QR พร้อมเพย์ตามมาตรฐาน EMVCo ด้วยเบอร์โทร บัตรประชาชน หรือ e-Wallet แสดง QR ที่สแกนได้จริงและส่งออกเป็น SVG

mods.name: cyber-guard-th
mods.description: ยามความปลอดภัย: บล็อกคำสั่ง Bash ทำลายระบบก่อนรัน สแกนหา secret ที่หลุด โค้ดเสี่ยง และ package.json ที่น่าสงสัย

mods.name: stripe-dashboard-th
mods.description: ดูยอดขายจาก Stripe จริง (อ่าน key จาก STRIPE_SECRET_KEY) วันนี้ สัปดาห์ เดือน กราฟ และ MRR พร้อมโหมดข้อมูลตัวอย่าง

mods.name: market-tracker-th
mods.description: ราคาทองไทย ทองโลก หุ้น SET/US คริปโต และค่าเงินบาทจากแหล่งข้อมูลจริง พร้อม watchlist พอร์ต และแจ้งเตือนราคา

mods.name: dev-painkiller-th
mods.description: แก้ปัญหาที่ Dev เจอทุกวัน: พอร์ตชน, .env ไม่ครบ, console.log ค้าง, TODO, ไฟล์ใหญ่ใน git, branch รก, cache บวม

mods.name: translate-docs-th
mods.description: แปลข้อความ ไฟล์ คอมเมนต์ และไฟล์ภาษา (i18n) ด้วย Claude และสร้าง README กับ API Docs จากโค้ด

mods.name: seo-scanner-th
mods.description: ตรวจ SEO ของหน้าเว็บจริง: title, description, heading, alt รูป, OG tags, canonical, robots.txt, sitemap, ลิงก์เสีย พร้อมคะแนนและวิธีแก้

mods.name: status-page-th
mods.description: ทำหน้า Status Page: เช็ค service จริงทาง HTTP, เก็บ uptime, บันทึก incident และส่งออก HTML หลายธีม

mods.name: agent-monitor-th
mods.description: Task Manager ของ subagent: ดูสถานะ จำนวน tool และ token ของแต่ละ agent สด ๆ ในแผง และหยุด agent ที่ทำงานนานเกินได้

mods.name: app-scheduler-th
mods.description: ตั้งเวลาเปิดเว็บ แอป หรือไฟล์อัตโนมัติ รายวัน วันทำงาน หรือครั้งเดียว ขณะเปิด Claude Code อยู่

mods.name: booking-system-th
mods.description: ระบบจองห้อง โต๊ะ สนาม หรือคิว เก็บในเครื่อง กันจองซ้อน ดูปฏิทินรายวัน สรุปรายได้ และส่งออก CSV

mods.name: network-tool-th
mods.description: เครื่องมือเครือข่าย: ping, traceroute, DNS, WHOIS, IP ของเรา, HTTP header, speed test, เช็คพอร์ต และ Wi-Fi

mods.name: trip-planner-th
mods.description: ผู้ช่วยเที่ยว: ให้ Claude วางแผนทริป ทำลิงก์ค้นตั๋วเครื่องบิน รถ รถไฟ และเก็บตั๋วที่จองแล้วพร้อมนับถอยหลัง

mods.name: media-playlist-th
mods.description: จัด Playlist จาก YouTube, Spotify หรือไฟล์ในเครื่อง กดเล่นแล้วเปิดให้ มีคิว สุ่ม วนซ้ำ และส่งออก M3U

mods.name: movie-finder-th
mods.description: ค้นหาหนังและซีรีส์ (Wikipedia, TVmaze) เปิดค้นใน Netflix YouTube Disney+ Prime ทำ watchlist ให้คะแนน และให้ Claude แนะนำเรื่องต่อไป

mods.name: dev-awake-th
mods.description: แก้ง่วงสำหรับ Dev: มุกโปรแกรมเมอร์ ควิซ โจทย์โค้ดสั้นๆ Pomodoro และเตือนพัก ดื่มน้ำ พักสายตา ขณะเขียนโค้ดนานๆ

mods.name: agent-tips-th
mods.description: ทิปสั่ง Claude Code วันละข้อ พร้อม template prompt ที่ใช้ได้จริง ค้นหา บันทึกเป็นรายการโปรด และเติมลงช่องพิมพ์ให้ทันที

mods.name: dev-exercise-th
mods.description: ท่ายืดเหยียดแก้ Office Syndrome ที่ทำได้ที่โต๊ะ มีแผงนับเวลาทีละท่า และเตือนให้ลุกขยับทุกชั่วโมง

mods.name: daily-figures-th
mods.description: บุคคลสำคัญประจำวันจาก Wikipedia: ใครเกิดวันนี้ในประวัติศาสตร์ เรื่องย่อ และบทเรียนที่ Claude สรุปให้

mods.name: spinner-th
mods.description: เปลี่ยน spinner ตอน Claude กำลังทำงาน 20 แบบ รวมแบบไทย (ตุ๊กตุ๊ก ดอกบัว กาแฟ) และคำกริยาภาษาไทย

mods.name: drum-th
mods.description: กลองชุดในแผง ตีด้วยปุ่มคีย์บอร์ด อัดจังหวะ เล่นซ้ำ และ beat สำเร็จรูป ใช้เสียงที่สังเคราะห์เอง

mods.name: dev-unblock-th
mods.description: ช่วย Dev ที่คิดไม่ออก: ถามคำถามนำ แตกงานเป็นขั้นเล็กๆ ด้วย Claude อิงจาก git diff ล่าสุด และจดว่าติดตรงไหนบ่อย

mods.name: trend-th
mods.description: เทรนด์ล่าสุดจากแหล่งจริง: Google Trends ไทย, Hacker News, GitHub repo มาแรง, คริปโตมาแรง และ Wikipedia ที่คนอ่านมากสุด

mods.name: gcloud-th
mods.description: ดูสถานะ Google Cloud ผ่าน gcloud CLI: บัญชี โปรเจกต์ VM Cloud Run และ billing พร้อม template คำสั่งที่ใช้บ่อย (อ่านอย่างเดียว)

mods.name: mockup-th
mods.description: สร้าง mockup จริงจากโลโก้ของคุณ: เสื้อ แก้ว ถุงผ้า กล่อง มือถือ แล็ปท็อป เป็นไฟล์ SVG และทำใบสั่งงานส่งร้านสกรีน

mods.name: stamp-th
mods.description: ตรายางดิจิทัล: ปั๊มตรา อนุมัติ ด่วน ลับ เสร็จแล้ว หรือข้อความของคุณเอง พร้อมวันที่ เป็นไฟล์ SVG และปั๊มลงแผงแบบสนุกๆ

mods.name: privacy-shield-th
mods.description: โหมดความเป็นส่วนตัวตอนแชร์จอหรือมีคนเดินผ่าน: กดแล้วแผงสงบๆ บังจอ ซ่อนข้อมูลลับในแถบสถานะ และโหมดโฟกัส

mods.name: timer-th
mods.description: จับเวลาหลายตัวพร้อมกัน: นับถอยหลัง จับเวลาเดินหน้า และบันทึกเวลาทำงานแยกโปรเจกต์ พร้อมรายงานรายวัน

mods.name: kawaii-th
mods.description: เพื่อนน่ารักเหนือช่องพิมพ์ที่เปลี่ยนสีหน้าตาม Claude: คิดอยู่ ทำงาน เจอ error ทำเสร็จ พร้อม kaomoji 50 แบบ

mods.name: celebrate-th
mods.description: ฉลองความสำเร็จ: เทสต์ผ่าน commit สำเร็จ หรือ deploy เสร็จ จะมีพลุในแผง เสียงแตร และสถิติความสำเร็จ

mods.name: ai-limit-th
mods.description: ดู limit การใช้ Claude แบบน่ารัก: % ที่ใช้ไปของรอบ 5 ชม. และ 7 วัน เวลารีเซ็ต context ที่เหลือ และเตือนก่อนเต็ม

mods.name: sqlite-th
mods.description: ใช้ SQLite ใน Claude Code: เปิดฐานข้อมูล ดูตาราง schema รัน query แสดงเป็นตาราง ส่งออก CSV ผ่าน sqlite3 หรือ Python

mods.name: rainbow-friends-th
mods.description: เพื่อนสายรุ้ง ASCII ที่ออกแบบใหม่ทั้งหมด: แมวสายรุ้ง ยูนิคอร์น ช้างน้อย ปลาทอง วิ่งในแผงเป็นแอนิเมชันสีรุ้ง

mods.name: ghost-debug-th
mods.description: ผีไทยมาบอก error: เมื่อคำสั่งที่ Claude รันพัง จะมีผีประจำ bug มาอธิบายอาการ สาเหตุ วิธีแก้ เป็นภาษาไทย/อีสาน และให้ Claude แปล error เป็นภาษาคนได้

mods.name: tool-timeline-th
mods.description: ไทม์ไลน์การทำงานของ Claude: จับเวลาทุก tool โชว์เวลาใต้แต่ละแถว บอกตัวที่ช้าสุดของรอบ และกราฟแกนต์ในแผง

mods.name: code-critic-th
mods.description: รีวิวโค้ดที่ Claude เพิ่งแก้ด้วย AI ตัวที่สอง (Haiku) ภาษาไทย แบบตรงๆ หรือแบบน่ารัก และเตือนเมื่อไฟล์ถูกแก้วนหลายรอบ

mods.name: project-memory-th
mods.description: สมองที่สองข้าม session: จดสิ่งที่ Claude ควรจำเกี่ยวกับโปรเจกต์ (แบบส่วนตัว ไม่ลง repo) แล้วแนบให้ Claude อ่านทุกครั้งอัตโนมัติ

mods.name: git-guard-th
mods.description: ยามเฝ้า Git: ถามก่อนทิ้งงานที่ยังไม่ commit (เสนอ stash ให้), กัน force push, สำรองไฟล์ก่อน rm -rf, ตรวจ Conventional Commits และสลับ branch อย่างปลอดภัย

mods.name: git-writer-th
mods.description: นักเขียนประจำ Git: แต่งข้อความ commit จาก diff (ปกติ/Conventional/แบบกวีน่ารัก), เขียน PR จาก commit แล้วสร้างด้วย gh และสรุปงานวันนี้เป็นโพสต์โซเชียล

mods.name: docker-pilot-th
mods.description: แดชบอร์ด Docker ในแผงข้าง Claude Code: container ที่รัน/ตาย CPU แรม พอร์ต ดู log สั่ง start/stop/restart และดู Pod ของ Kubernetes ที่มีปัญหา

mods.name: dev-dictionary-th
mods.description: พจนานุกรมศัพท์ Dev ภาษาไทย 60 คำ อธิบายแบบเข้าใจง่ายพร้อมตัวอย่างเปรียบเทียบ คำที่ไม่มีให้ Claude อธิบายแบบเด็ก 5 ขวบ และกระซิบความหมายเมื่อคุณพิมพ์ศัพท์ยาก

mods.name: code-insight-th
mods.description: เจาะลึกโปรเจกต์จาก git: แผนที่โฟลเดอร์พร้อมคำอธิบายโดย Claude, ใครเป็นเจ้าของโค้ดส่วนไหน, ไฟล์ที่ถูกแก้บ่อยสุด (hotspot) และประวัติของไฟล์

mods.name: port-guard-th
mods.description: ยามเฝ้าพอร์ต: คอยดูพอร์ตสำคัญ (3000, 5173, 5432 ...) เด้งเตือนเมื่อ server ที่รันอยู่ตาย หรือมีโปรแกรมอื่นมายึดพอร์ต และเตือนก่อน Claude สั่งรัน server บนพอร์ตที่ไม่ว่าง

mods.name: spinner-arcade-th
mods.description: เกมเล็กๆ ใต้ spinner ตอนรอ Claude คิดนาน: แพคแมนวิ่งกินจุดสะสมแต้ม และเปลี่ยนเป็นสีพาสเทลพร้อมคำปลอบใจเมื่อเจอ error หลายครั้ง

mods.name: file-badges-th
mods.description: ป้ายสีตามภาษาหน้าแถว tool ที่อ่าน/แก้ไฟล์ (TS เหลือง, PY ฟ้า, RS ส้ม ...) ให้กวาดตาแล้วรู้ทันทีว่า Claude แตะไฟล์อะไร และสรุปภาษาที่แตะใน session

mods.name: log-fold-th
mods.description: พับ output ยาวๆ ของคำสั่ง Bash: เห็นหัว 10 บรรทัด ท้าย 10 บรรทัด และดึงบรรทัด error/warning ที่ซ่อนอยู่ตรงกลางขึ้นมาให้เห็น พร้อมสีแดง/เหลือง

mods.name: session-bridge-th
mods.description: ท่อเชื่อมระหว่าง Claude Code หลายหน้าต่าง: ดูว่ามี session ไหนเปิดอยู่ ส่งข้อความ/ผลงานล่าสุดไปให้อีก session และดูกล่องข้อความที่ได้รับ

mods.name: progress-plant-th
mods.description: ต้นไม้ในแถบสถานะที่โตตามจำนวนบรรทัดโค้ดที่ Claude เขียนให้วันนี้ 🌰→🌱→🌿→🪴→🌳→🌸→🍎 และสวนที่สะสมต้นไม้ของแต่ละวัน

mods.name: focus-aura-th
mods.description: ออร่าโฟกัสสีพาสเทลเหนือช่องพิมพ์ระหว่างที่ Claude กำลังทำงาน บอกว่ากำลังทำเรื่องอะไรและผ่านไปกี่นาที หายใจเป็นจังหวะให้ใจเย็น และบอกเวลาเมื่อเสร็จ

mods.name: prompt-coach-th
mods.description: โค้ชเขียน prompt: ให้ AI ตัวเล็ก (Haiku) ดูว่าคำสั่งกำกวมไหมก่อนส่งให้ Claude ถ้ากำกวมจะถามกลับพร้อมตัวเลือก แล้วเติมคำตอบให้อัตโนมัติ (เปิดเองเมื่อต้องการ)

mods.name: test-fixer-th
mods.description: วนแก้เทสต์อัตโนมัติ: รันเทสต์ ถ้าไม่ผ่านส่ง error ให้ Claude แก้ แล้วรันซ้ำเองจนผ่าน มีเพดานรอบ หยุดเมื่อ error ซ้ำเดิม และห้ามแก้เทสต์ให้ผ่านแบบโกง

mods.name: log-heatmap-th
mods.description: แผนที่ความร้อนของไฟล์ log: แกนเวลา × ระดับ (INFO เขียว, WARN เหลือง, ERROR แดง) เห็นทันทีว่าพังช่วงไหน พร้อม error ที่เจอบ่อยสุด อ่านจากไฟล์หรือ docker logs ก็ได้

mods.name: matrix-rain-th
mods.description: ฝนตัวอักษรสีเขียวแบบหนัง The Matrix ในแผงข้าง Claude Code พร้อมถอดรหัสข้อความของคุณกลางจอ (terminal ใช้ Raster, VS Code/Desktop ใช้ SVG)

mods.name: aquarium-th
mods.description: ตู้ปลาในแผงข้าง Claude Code: ปลาหลายสีว่ายไปมา ฟองอากาศลอยขึ้น สาหร่ายโยก ให้อาหารแล้วปลาว่ายมากิน เพิ่มปลาได้ และโหมดกลางคืน

mods.name: screensaver-th
mods.description: ภาพพักหน้าจอยุค 90 ในแผง 5 ฉาก: ลูกบาศก์ 3D หมุน, บินผ่านดวงดาว, โคมไฟลาวา, โลโก้กระดอนแบบ DVD, หิมะตก เปิดเองเมื่อไม่มีใครพิมพ์ และปิดเองเมื่อกลับมา

mods.name: retro-arcade-th
mods.description: ตู้เกมยุค 80 ในแผงข้าง Claude Code: Pong (สู้กับ AI), Breakout (ทุบอิฐสีรุ้ง), Flappy (นกกระพือปีกหลบท่อ) เล่นด้วยคีย์บอร์ด เก็บสถิติสูงสุด

mods.name: puzzle-box-th
mods.description: เกมฝึกสมองในแผงข้าง Claude Code: 2048 (ไล่สีตามตัวเลข) และ Minesweeper กู้ระเบิด (ตาแรกปลอดภัยเสมอ) เล่นด้วยคีย์บอร์ด เก็บสถิติ

mods.name: typing-racer-th
mods.description: แข่งพิมพ์เร็วในแผง: ประโยคโค้ด/คำสั่ง Dev ภาษาไทยและอังกฤษ รถแข่งวิ่งตามความคืบหน้า แข่งกับผีของสถิติตัวเอง วัด WPM และความแม่นยำ

mods.name: code-diagram-th
mods.description: แปลงโค้ดเป็นภาพ: ให้ Claude วาด flowchart / class diagram เป็นกล่อง ASCII จากไฟล์จริง และวาดผังการ import ระหว่างไฟล์ของโปรเจกต์ (คำนวณเองไม่ใช้ AI) บันทึกเป็น Markdown ได้

mods.name: image-view-th
mods.description: ดูรูปในแผงข้าง Claude Code ได้เลย (PNG/JPG/GIF/WebP), แปลงรูปเป็นภาพบล็อกสีแบบ pixel art และถาม Claude ว่าในรูปมีอะไร

mods.name: git-graph-th
mods.description: กราฟ git สีสวยในแผง: เส้น branch แยกสีตามเลน, HEAD/branch/tag เป็นป้ายสี, รีเฟรชเองหลัง Claude commit และสรุป branch ที่ยังไม่ merge

mods.name: system-monitor-th
mods.description: กราฟชีพจรเครื่องแบบสดในแผง: CPU และ RAM ย้อนหลัง 2 นาที ไล่สีเขียวถึงแดง พร้อมโปรแกรมที่กินแรมมากสุด และเตือนเมื่อเครื่องหนักนาน

mods.name: token-map-th
mods.description: แผนที่ความร้อนของ token: ไฟล์/โฟลเดอร์ไหนกิน context มากถ้าให้ Claude อ่าน, ไฟล์ที่ Claude อ่านจริงใน session นี้กินไปเท่าไร และแนะนำไฟล์ที่ควรใส่ ignore

mods.name: live-diff-th
mods.description: จอแยกสองแผง: ซ้ายเป็น git diff สีที่อัปเดตทันทีทุกครั้งที่ Claude แก้ไฟล์ ขวาเป็นผลลัพธ์คำสั่ง Bash ล่าสุด ไม่ต้องสลับหน้าต่างไปดูเอง

mods.name: context-keeper-th
mods.description: เฝ้า context และ prompt cache: แถบ % context และนับถอยหลัง cache เย็น แนะนำ compact ตอนงานจบช่วง และเขียนบันทึกส่งต่องาน (handoff) ไปเริ่ม session ใหม่

mods.name: prompt-queue-th
mods.description: คิวงานต่อท้าย /after: ส่งงานถัดไปให้ Claude เองเมื่องานปัจจุบันเสร็จ และ /aside ถามข้างทางในแผงโดยไม่เข้าบทสนทนาหลัก

mods.name: plan-progress-th
mods.description: ติดตามแผนงาน (TodoWrite) ของ Claude: แถบความคืบหน้าเหนือช่องพิมพ์ ข้อที่กำลังทำ จับเวลาแต่ละข้อ และฉลองเมื่อเสร็จครบ

mods.name: output-diet-th
mods.description: ตัด output ยาวของ Bash ก่อนส่งให้ Claude: เก็บหัว ท้าย และบรรทัด error เก็บฉบับเต็มลงไฟล์ ประหยัด context และนับ token ที่ประหยัดได้

mods.name: time-machine-th
mods.description: ย้อนเวลาไฟล์ที่ Claude แก้: ถ่ายภาพก่อน/หลังทุกการแก้ ดูไทม์ไลน์ ดู diff ทีละขั้น และ undo กลับไปขั้นไหนก็ได้ ไม่ต้องพึ่ง git

mods.name: loop-detective-th
mods.description: จับตอน Claude วนลองซ้ำ: คำสั่งเดิมพังซ้ำ แก้ไปแก้กลับ แก้ไฟล์เดิมรัวๆ เตือนเรา บอก Claude ให้หยุดคิด และโหมดเข้มงวดบล็อกการลองซ้ำ

mods.name: next-steps-th
mods.description: เดา prompt ถัดไป 3 ข้อหลังทุกคำตอบด้วย Haiku แสดงเหนือช่องพิมพ์ ช่องว่างอยู่กด 1-3 ใช้ได้เลย ข้อแรกกด Tab รับ

mods.name: secret-veil-th
mods.description: ปิด API key, token, รหัสผ่านในผลของ Bash/Read ก่อนถึง Claude เป็น ‹secret:N› และใส่ค่าจริงกลับให้ตอนรันคำสั่ง ค่าจริงไม่เข้า context

mods.name: session-wrapped-th
mods.description: สรุป session แบบ Spotify Wrapped: เผยสถิติทีละหน้า tool ที่ใช้บ่อย ไฟล์ที่รัก บุคลิก Claude ของคุณ และสร้างการ์ด HTML ไว้แชร์

mods.name: achievements-th
mods.description: ปลดล็อกความสำเร็จ 31 อย่างจากการทำงานกับ Claude: นกฮูกราตรี นักฆ่าบั๊ก พหุภาษา ไร้ที่ติ และตู้โชว์ในแผง เก็บข้าม session

mods.name: boss-fight-th
mods.description: เทสต์พัง = บอสผีไทยโผล่เหนือช่องพิมพ์ HP เท่าเทสต์ที่พัง แก้ได้ทีละตัว = ฟาด HP ลด ผ่านหมด = KO ได้ของรางวัล

mods.name: where-am-i-th
mods.description: เข็มทิศงาน: Haiku สรุปเหนือช่องพิมพ์ว่า เป้าหมาย เสร็จแล้ว รอคุณ ต่อไป กลับจากพักก็รู้ทันทีว่างานถึงไหน

mods.name: changes-receipt-th
mods.description: ใบเสร็จทุกรอบ: ไฟล์ที่สร้าง แก้ ลบ (+/- บรรทัด) รวมที่ทำผ่าน shell และสิ่งที่ลองแล้วไม่สำเร็จ

mods.name: collision-guard-th
mods.description: กันชนระหว่าง Claude หลายหน้าต่าง: ถามก่อนแก้ไฟล์ที่ Claude อีกหน้าต่างเพิ่งแก้ภายใน 30 นาที

mods.name: quick-prefix-th
mods.description: สัญลักษณ์นำหน้า prompt เปลี่ยนโหมดรอบเดียว: + คิดเต็มที่, _ ใช้ Haiku, ~ โหมดประหยัด

mods.name: md-preview-th
mods.description: ดู Markdown ที่ Claude แก้แบบเรนเดอร์ในแผงข้าง เทียบก่อน/หลังได้

mods.name: reminders-th
mods.description: ตั้งเตือนที่อยู่ข้าม session: /remind 30m, 17:30, พรุ่งนี้ 09:00 และส่งงานให้ Claude ตอนถึงเวลาได้

mods.name: ci-watch-th
mods.description: เฝ้า CI ของ GitHub ในแถบสถานะด้วย gh ไม่เสีย token เริ่มเองหลัง push และให้ Claude แก้เมื่อพังได้

mods.name: narrator-th
mods.description: นักพากย์: งานนานเสร็จแล้วอ่านออกเสียงสรุปว่า Claude ทำอะไร ภาษาไทยหรืออังกฤษ

mods.name: thai-news-th
mods.description: ข่าวไทยล่าสุดจาก Google News เหนือช่องพิมพ์ เลือกหมวดได้ และให้ Claude สรุปข่าวเด่น

mods.name: pixel-crew
mods.description: Pixel-art progress bar with the Claude mascot and a side panel that turns your subagents into a crew of characters (developer, artist, researcher, tester, Codex...).

mods.name: tsunu-avatar
mods.description: 阿宇的立繪跟著 Claude Code 的狀態換圖，並把狀態送給桌面小視窗。

mods.name: idle-compact
mods.description: Compacts the main conversation once it has sat idle for idleMinutes, while the prompt cache is still warm, and hands every compaction of the main conversation (manual, auto, plugin, precompute) the Compact Instructions section of the user's AGENTS.md. Skips while a turn runs, below minMessageTokens…

mods.name: mokkan
mods.description: Cross-session reminders: /mokkan toggles a live pane with your TODOs, Reminders and Archived tabs, /mokkan <command> runs push, in, edit, ack, done and the rest at once, and the /mokkan:mokkan skill lets Claude do it for you.

mods.name: ccdrawu
mods.description: A sidebar and a status line for Claude Code: usage limits, context, model, cost, git and session stats in a pane beside the transcript, or under the prompt

mods.name: signet-eval-functions
mods.description: Optional Claude Code 2.1.274 and 2.1.280 function hooks for Signet-eval policy and output redaction

mods.name: cachebeat
mods.description: Keeps the prompt cache warm while a session sits idle: shortly before the cache would expire, a small background request re-reads it, without touching the transcript. A beating heart under the prompt shows it working, and Claude can read and change it for you. Each beat counts toward your usage.

mods.name: let-them-talk
mods.description: Adds /let-them-talk, which starts Let Them Talk and opens it in your browser; shows Claude Code's suggested next prompt in its Send box; and runs a Chat in IDE started from it on the model picked there.

mods.name: session-models
mods.description: Shows the main model and its effort, the live agents by model and effort, named agent crews, and the working directory, and warns about agent crowds and huge contexts

mods.name: subagent-limits
mods.description: Keeps subagents small: tells the main agent how to size and split work, asks a growing subagent to checkpoint, and refuses its tools past a hard limit so a fresh agent takes over

mods.name: usage-limits
mods.description: Keeps the 5-hour and weekly limit windows, their burn rate, a run-out projection, context fill, session cost and prompt-cache drops in a dim line above the prompt

mods.name: worktrees
mods.description: Gives every agent that can edit a git worktree of its own, runs a project's setup script with its own port range, stops only the processes that setup script recorded, removes an agent's worktree and branch once the session merges it, and tidies other merged branches on demand with /tidy

mods.name: tokensaver
mods.description: Clawd, a token-saving assistant: has Claude answer in the caveman voice (fewer words, every fact kept), trims noisy tool output and pasted logs before they fill your context, tells you when to compact (and does it in one click), warns when the prompt cache goes cold, and routes sub-agents to cheape…

mods.name: cc-side
mods.description: A separate agent conversation in Claude Code's right-hand pane, forked from the current context.

mods.name: env-tabs
mods.description: Pin projects in Claude Desktop's Code tab: a Projects pane with the pinned ones on top, and a tab above the prompt for each.

mods.name: ambition-mod
mods.description: /ambition rewrites a draft prompt to be more ambitious (outcome-first, raw material, outside verification, optional proposals) in seconds, from what your session knows and the code, ending with an interview for what only you can answer, into your prompt box (go sends it).

mods.name: agent-models
mods.description: Each Claude subagent's model and effort in the native agent list, beside its task

mods.name: codex
mods.description: OpenAI Codex as native Claude Code subagents: the Agent tool starts one and the mod drives codex app-server in its place, no model in between

mods.name: link
mods.description: Click a file path in a reply and Finder opens with it selected

mods.name: peek
mods.description: Images in the terminal: Claude shows the pictures it makes or finds inline, as real pixels in kitty and Ghostty and as a colored-block preview elsewhere

mods.name: colorwheel
mods.description: ColorWheel: replies in Claude Code Desktop drawn with the app's own HTML markdown, alert cards, and themed full-width mermaid diagrams and charts that follow light and dark mode.

mods.name: model-picker
mods.description: Pick the model with one keypress when a session opens, no /model needed.

mods.name: mixture-of-models
mods.description: Routes each prompt to the cheapest capable model. Simple and coding work runs in a headless child Claude Code on an Anthropic-compatible gateway (Palgu, OpenRouter, a LiteLLM proxy; GLM 5.3, Kimi K3.1 Pro, DeepSeek, MiniMax, GPT-6, ...); critical work stays in your main session on your subscription…

mods.name: smartcompact
mods.description: A Claude Code mod that compacts the conversation at the right moment with a summary focused on the current task, and then picks the work back up.

mods.name: context-meter
mods.description: Reads each model request's own usage, shows the real context fill above the prompt, vetoes an auto-compact the advisor's double-counted usage would fire, and sends the handoff nudge once at 80%.

mods.name: quick-look
mods.description: Collects the files the agent reads, writes or names in its answer, and opens them in macOS Quick Look from a /ql command or a pane, in any terminal including Warp.

mods.name: chat-bubbles
mods.description: Messenger-style chat for Claude Code: your prompts on the right in a rival color, Claude on the left, only running or failing tools stand out. 441 themes.

mods.name: ekip-renkleri
mods.description: Oturumda kimin çalıştığını renkli küçük tuş avatarlarıyla gösterir: Claude, alt ajanlar (modele göre renk) ve Codex.

mods.name: sipp
mods.description: A passive-aggressive water reminder that costs zero tokens.

mods.name: raven
mods.description: A live preview pane beside the transcript: the session's diff with review comments, and rendered plans and docs as Claude writes them.

mods.name: tadhkir-loop
mods.description: Zikr, the 99 names of Allah and authentic hadith in Claude Code's spinner while Claude works.

mods.name: ashlr
mods.description: Open-source Claude Code plugin — 54 MCP tools and 39 slash commands, hybrid LLM summarization (Anthropic Haiku 4.5 default + ONNX offline + local opt-in), GitHub OAuth sign-in, auto-genome from public repos, cloud-genome pull on session start, PreToolUse redirect hooks (ASHLR_HOOK_MODE), unified $/…

mods.name: modmgr
mods.description: Search Claude Code mods, see what each can reach before you install it, and install, toggle, update or remove them with /mods.

mods.name: crew-chief
mods.description: Difficulty-based routing for Claude Code. You pick the main model and effort; Claude decides what to do itself and what to hand to tiered Haiku, Sonnet, and Opus subagents (including browser and emulator UI testers), escalates when a tier gets stuck, and follows your overrides like "do it yourself"…

mods.name: audit-pack
mods.description: Three read-only audit commands in one mod: /secret-scan, /conflicts and /licenses. They read git, project files and dependency folders. They copy results to the clipboard.

mods.name: authors
mods.description: Adds /authors: the top 15 contributors by commit count with their last commit date, from git log. Names only, never email addresses. Read-only. Copies the result to your clipboard.

mods.name: auto-format
mods.description: Runs your project's own formatter on each file Claude writes or edits, only when the project has a formatter config, and tells Claude to re-read the file.

mods.name: auto-lint
mods.description: Runs your project's own linter fix (eslint, ruff or golangci-lint) on each file Claude writes or edits, only when the project has that linter's config, and tells Claude what is left.

mods.name: band-pack
mods.description: The first six Baselane band meters in one row above the prompt: session cost, lattes, context bar, today's spend, the focus timer and the mood ring.

mods.name: bead
mods.description: Adds /bead <id>: one bead with status, priority, labels, description, blockers and children. Read with bd, the beads tracker. Read-only. Prints only, copies nothing.

mods.name: bead-chime
mods.description: Plays a short chime when a Bash call that ran bd close (or bd done) ends with exit code 0. It reads only the command text and the result, and runs no program.

mods.name: bead-now
mods.description: A band above the prompt with the bead in progress you updated last and how many more are in progress, read with bd list every 2 minutes and after Claude runs bd. Hidden when none is.

mods.name: bead-streak
mods.description: Counts the days in a row you closed a bead, from Bash calls that ran bd close and exited 0. Adds /bead-streak and a toast on a new best. Reads command text only, runs no program.

mods.name: beads-band
