mods.description: A band above the prompt with your beads counts (bd 97 ready · 45 active · 29 blocked), read with bd status every 2 minutes and after Claude runs bd. Hidden without bd or a beads project.

mods.name: beads-bars
mods.description: All six beads bands in one row: counts, the bead in progress, epic progress, done percent, closed today and open by priority, read with bd every 2 minutes and after Claude runs bd.

mods.name: beads-guard
mods.description: Asks before bd commands that delete data or rewrite history: delete, purge, prune, gc, sql, admin, import, rename, forget, restore, migrate and more. Reads only the command text, runs no bd.

mods.name: beads-pane
mods.description: A live side pane of your beads: in progress, ready and blocked issues, 10 each, with counts. Read with bd, read-only, after Bash calls. Open it with /beads.

mods.name: beads-prime
mods.description: Runs bd prime once per session and adds its text (max 8 KB) to the system prompt, from the repo's .beads files and bd memories. bd setup claude hooks may add it twice.

mods.name: branch-band
mods.description: A band above the prompt with the git branch and the count of changed files, read with git status after each Bash call and file edit.

mods.name: branches
mods.description: Adds /branches: local branches merged into the default branch or idle for 30 days, as a cleanup list, read with git. Never deletes. Copies the result to your clipboard.

mods.name: break-nudge
mods.description: Suggests a short break once the session has run 90 minutes, and again every 90 minutes after that.

mods.name: bullet-mode
mods.description: Replies as short bullet lists, at most one sentence per bullet, unless you ask for code.

mods.name: cache-meter
mods.description: A band above the prompt with the share of prompt tokens the cache served this session (cache 87%). A high share means cheaper, faster turns.

mods.name: changelog
mods.description: Adds /changelog: commits since the last tag (or the last 30), read with git log and grouped by conventional-commit type, as Markdown. Copies the result to your clipboard.

mods.name: chmod-guard
mods.description: Asks before chmod makes files world-writable (777, a+w, o+w) or chmod or chown runs recursively on a broad path (/, a system folder, a home folder).

mods.name: ci-band
mods.description: A band above the prompt with the latest GitHub Actions run of your branch (ci passed, ci failed, ci running), asked of the gh CLI every 2 minutes; branch read with git. Hidden without gh.

mods.name: clippy
mods.description: One helpful toast per session per trigger, in the classic paperclip voice: when you edit a migrations folder, a Dockerfile or a GitHub workflow, or run rm -rf. At most one toast per turn.

mods.name: code-only
mods.description: Replies with the code or command first and at most two short sentences of prose, unless asked to explain.

mods.name: commit-msg
mods.description: Adds /commit-msg: a Conventional Commits message proposed from the staged diff, read with git. Heuristic, no model call, writes nothing. Copies the result to your clipboard.

mods.name: conflicts
mods.description: Adds /conflicts: tracked files that still hold merge conflict markers, with line numbers, found with git grep. Read-only. Copies the result to your clipboard.

mods.name: cost-meter
mods.description: A band above the prompt with the session cost so far and what the last turn cost.

mods.name: cost-pane
mods.description: A live side pane with the session cost, the cost of each of the last 10 turns as a bar, and the average per turn. Open it with /cost-pane.

mods.name: cron-guard
mods.description: Asks before scheduled jobs or services are wiped or stopped: crontab -r, crontab replaced from stdin or a file, launchctl unload or bootout, systemctl stop, disable or mask.

mods.name: ctx-nudge
mods.description: Reminds you to /clear or /compact when the context window passes 75 percent.

mods.name: daily-spend
mods.description: A band above the prompt with today's total cost across all your sessions.

mods.name: deps
mods.description: Adds /deps: direct dependencies with versions from package.json, pyproject.toml, requirements.txt, go.mod and Cargo.toml at the repo root. No network. Read-only. Copies the result to your clipboard.

mods.name: dev-band
mods.description: The developer band in one row above the prompt: git branch and changed files (read with git status), wall clock and session age, tool counts, and failed tool calls.

mods.name: diff-stats
mods.description: Edit and Write rows show a compact +12 -3 bar beside the file name: green for lines added, red for lines removed, up to 20 cells.

mods.name: docs-nudge
mods.description: At turn end, one toast when edits added exported code (an export statement in .ts or .js, or a public function signature) and no README or docs file was edited this session.

mods.name: eli5-mode
mods.description: Explains like the reader is new: analogies first, no jargon without a one-line definition.

mods.name: env-check
mods.description: Adds /env-check: variable names in .env.example against .env at the git repo root, listing missing and extra names. Reads names only, never a value. Read-only. Copies the result to your clipboard.

mods.name: envinfo
mods.description: Adds /envinfo: versions of git, node, npm, python3, go, rustc and docker if installed, by running each (2 s limit), and the OS. Read-only. Copies the result to your clipboard.

mods.name: epic-bar
mods.description: A band above the prompt with the progress of the epic you work on, or of the open epic nearest to done (bm-ooq ███████░ 7/8), read with bd. Hidden without epics or bd.

mods.name: epics-pane
mods.description: A live side pane of each open beads epic: a bar of closed and total children, and a mark when it is ready to close. Read with bd, read-only. Open it with /epics.

mods.name: error-meter
mods.description: A band above the prompt with how many tool calls failed this session (an error or a deny) and which tool failed last. Red from the first failure.

mods.name: exit-badge
mods.description: A failed Bash row shows a small red badge with its exit code, for example exit 2.

mods.name: file-links
mods.description: In Claude's replies, path/to/file.ts:42 references to files in your project become links. Click one to put @path/to/file.ts in the prompt.

mods.name: file-owners
mods.description: Adds /owners <path>: the top 5 authors of a file or folder by lines, from git blame. Names only, never addresses. Read-only. Copies the result to your clipboard.

mods.name: files-pane
mods.description: A live side pane of the files Claude read, edited or wrote this session, grouped by action with a count per file, newest first. Open it with /files.

mods.name: focus-pack
mods.description: Three quiet nudges in one mod: commit after 8 edits, TODO/FIXME/HACK lines added, and debug prints added.

mods.name: fun-pack
mods.description: Fun habits in one install: caveman prose and gitmoji commit messages. They compose: caveman never touches commit messages.

mods.name: git-pane
mods.description: A live side pane, read with git: the branch, ahead and behind its upstream, changed files (staged and unstaged) and the last 5 commits. Refreshes after git commands and edits. Open it with /git.

mods.name: guard-pack
mods.description: The 15 core Baselane guards in one mod (secrets, git, infra, packages, path jail). Some read git, measure files with find, read HOME with printenv, or check where a path really lands.

mods.name: handoff
mods.description: Adds /handoff: writes a session summary with the git status to .claude/handoff.md (never overwriting) and answers with the path. Copies the result to your clipboard.

mods.name: heatmap
mods.description: Adds /heatmap: a 12-week calendar grid of the days you used Claude Code, like a contribution graph, shaded by turns, naming your busiest day.

mods.name: hotspots
mods.description: Adds /hotspots: the 10 files changed most often in the last 90 days, from git log, with change counts. Read-only. Copies the result to your clipboard.

mods.name: infra-guard
mods.description: Asks before terraform destroy, kubectl delete, force-push, DROP TABLE or rm -rf.

mods.name: issue-links
mods.description: #123 references in Claude's replies become links to that issue when the repository's origin is on GitHub or GitLab. Display only.

mods.name: k8s-guard
mods.description: Asks before kubectl apply or replace with --force, kubectl drain, helm uninstall, and kubectl delete behind global flags (plain kubectl delete is infra-guard's).

mods.name: langs
mods.description: Counts the file types Claude edits across sessions and adds /langs: a bar list of the types edited most, each file counted once per session.

mods.name: licenses
mods.description: Adds /licenses: the licence of each direct dependency, from node_modules and Python dist-info at the git repo root. Shows unknown when it cannot tell. Read-only. Copies the result to your clipboard.

mods.name: loc
mods.description: Adds /loc: lines of tracked text files by language, read with git, sorted, with a total. Skips lockfiles and binaries. Read-only. Copies the result to your clipboard.

mods.name: mood-ring
mods.description: A band above the prompt with a colored dot and a word for the error and block rate of your last 20 tool calls: calm (green) under 10 percent, tense (yellow) under 30, stormy (red) from 30.

mods.name: night-owl
mods.description: Records the hour of each prompt across sessions and adds /hours: a 24-hour histogram of when you work, naming your peak hour.

mods.name: no-em-dash
mods.description: Never writes the em-dash character. Uses a comma, colon, period or parentheses.

mods.name: noir-mode
mods.description: Prose like a hard-boiled detective narrator, light and clear. Code, commands, commit messages and error text stay exact.

mods.name: nudge-pack
mods.description: Two turn-end reminders in one mod: test-reminder and ctx-nudge.

mods.name: ops-band
mods.description: The ops band in one row above the prompt: commits ahead and behind the upstream (git), the latest GitHub Actions run of your branch (gh), and the Mac battery (pmset).

mods.name: path-jail
mods.description: Asks before Write, Edit or NotebookEdit changes a file outside the working directory, by real path.

mods.name: pomodoro
mods.description: A band above the prompt with a 25/5 focus timer (focus 18:42, break 03:10). Start and stop it with /pomodoro; a toast marks each switch.

mods.name: port-watch
mods.description: A live side pane of the local TCP ports that listen, with the process name and pid, refreshed every 10 seconds while open. Reads lsof (macOS, most Linux). Open it with /ports.

mods.name: ready
mods.description: Adds /ready: the 20 top ready beads, one line each, and the total. Read with bd, the beads tracker. Read-only. Prints only, copies nothing.

mods.name: receipt
mods.description: Adds /receipt: a shareable receipt of the session (tools, files, commands, blocks, context, cost), printed and copied.

mods.name: recent
mods.description: Adds /recent: your last 15 commits across all local branches (author is git user.name), with branch and date. Read-only. Copies the result to your clipboard.

mods.name: repo-pack
mods.description: Five read-only repo commands in one mod: /todos, /loc, /hotspots, /commit-msg and /branches. They read git. They copy results to the clipboard.

mods.name: say-done
mods.description: On macOS, speaks "Claude is done" with the say command when a turn ends after more than 30 seconds. Does nothing on other platforms.

mods.name: scripts
mods.description: Adds /scripts: runnable tasks from package.json scripts, Makefile targets, justfile recipes and pyproject scripts at the git repo root. Read-only. Copies the result to your clipboard.

mods.name: sha-links
mods.description: Commit SHAs in Claude's replies, and in the output of git commands, become links to the commit page when origin is on GitHub or GitLab. Display only.

mods.name: size
mods.description: Adds /size: the 15 largest tracked files and the total tracked size at HEAD, read with git. Read-only. Copies the result to your clipboard.

mods.name: size-badge
mods.description: Read and Write rows show how much was read or written: the line count, for example 312 lines, or the file size for images and PDFs.

mods.name: sounds-zen
mods.description: Soft bells and singing-bowl tones: a bell when tests pass, a low bowl when they fail, a muted chime when a call is blocked, a bowl when a turn ends.

mods.name: ssh-guard
mods.description: Asks before a private key in .ssh is read, authorized_keys or the SSH config is changed, or ssh-keygen would overwrite a key. Public keys and ssh -i pass. Reads HOME with printenv.

mods.name: standup
mods.description: Adds /standup: Yesterday, Today and Blockers from your git log and this session's record, printed and copied.

mods.name: stashes
mods.description: Adds /stashes: git stashes with their age and the branch each was made on. Read-only, never applies or drops. Copies the result to your clipboard.

mods.name: stats-pack
mods.description: The three original stats mods in one: /wrapped (copied to your clipboard), streaks and achievements on one shared daily rollup.

mods.name: ste-mode
mods.description: Replies in ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English: approved words, short sentences, one instruction each, active voice.

mods.name: streaks
mods.description: Counts consecutive days you used Claude Code: a Day N streak toast at session start, and /streak to ask.

mods.name: sudo-guard
mods.description: Asks before sudo, doas or su -c runs a command with elevated rights.

mods.name: tag-guard
mods.description: Asks before release tags go to a remote: git push --tags, --follow-tags or --mirror, a push of a tag ref, and a push that deletes a remote tag. Dry runs pass. Reads tags with git.

mods.name: tdd-mode
mods.description: Writes a failing test first, watches it fail, then implements.

mods.name: team-pack
mods.description: Team habits in one install: Conventional Commits, test-first work and a security check on every change.

mods.name: terse-mode
mods.description: Short answers: no preamble, no recap.

mods.name: test-pane
mods.description: A live side pane with the last test run (vitest, jest, pytest, go test, cargo test, bun test, claude plugin test): runner, pass, fail and skip counts, duration and first failures. Open it with /tests.

mods.name: time-badge
mods.description: Tool rows show how long the call ran, for example 2.4s, when it took over one second. The time is the tool's own run time, without permission prompts.

mods.name: todo-count
mods.description: A band above the prompt with how many lines in tracked files hold TODO, FIXME or HACK (todo 12), counted with git after edits. Hidden when there are none.

mods.name: todo-nudge
mods.description: At turn end, one toast with the count of TODO, FIXME and HACK lines your edits added this turn. Quiet when none were added.

mods.name: todo-pane
mods.description: A live side pane of the TODO, FIXME and HACK lines in tracked files (git grep), grouped by file and capped at 30. It refreshes after file edits while open. Open it with /todo-pane.

mods.name: todos
mods.description: Adds /todos: TODO, FIXME and HACK lines in tracked files, found with git grep, grouped by file (50 lines at most). Read-only. Copies the result to your clipboard.

mods.name: tree
mods.description: Adds /tree: tracked files (git ls-files) as a tree, 2 levels deep, folders with file counts (80 lines at most). Read-only. Copies the result to your clipboard.

mods.name: turn-timer
mods.description: A band above the prompt with how long the current turn has run (turn 0:42). It shows while a turn runs and hides between turns.

mods.name: url-links
mods.description: https links (and http://localhost) in tool output are listed as clickable links under the result, up to five. Display only: Claude reads the output as it was.

mods.name: weekly
mods.description: Adds /week: this week (since Monday) against last week, with sessions, turns, tool calls, files edited and cost, and the change for each.

mods.name: wrapped
mods.description: Adds /wrapped: a screenshot-ready Claude Code Wrapped for the last 7 days (or /wrapped month for 30), printed and copied.

mods.name: yoda-mode
mods.description: Speaks like Yoda in prose. Code, commands and commit messages stay normal.

mods.name: tama
mods.description: Tamagotchi companion: fed by finished turns, quips in the spinner, /pet for its card

mods.name: next-prompts
mods.description: Suggests 3 next prompts after each turn; click one or type 1/2/3 + Enter to send it

mods.name: exo
mods.description: Claude Code plugin with four stages and hooks that refuse risky commands.

mods.name: autoresearch
mods.description: Autonomous experiment loop for Claude Code: run, measure, keep or discard. A port of pi-autoresearch.

mods.name: oh-my-toolbelt
mods.description: A toolbelt above the Claude Code prompt: clock, date, weather and a pomodoro on the left; your saved prompts, commands and one-press actions on the right; a panel for your prompts, notes, clipboard and settings.

mods.name: agent-graph
mods.description: Define agents with skills and context on a drag-and-drop graph, connect them, and run them locally or as Claude Managed Agents.

mods.name: dotclaude
mods.description: A workspace pane for Claude Code: vitals rail, edit gate (blocks Edit, Write, NotebookEdit and MultiEdit until you approve; not Bash or MCP tools), plan review, ledger, companion, Mac monitor, notes vault, radar, Git and crew.

mods.name: naiwa
mods.description: 奶蛙在终端里陪你写代码：能读懂上下文的台词、自己切换的心情、危险命令拦截，外加高光时刻的自动大笑彩蛋。

mods.name: publish-pulse
mods.description: Status line showing days since your last publish (traffic light) and the next scheduled release, read from Markdown files under NOTCH_PUBLISH_ROOT; also writes ~/.claude/notch/pulse.json for the cyxj-notch panel.

mods.name: quota-status
mods.description: Status line with 5-hour and weekly usage, reset day, session cost and prompt-cache countdown; toasts at 90% usage and 5 minutes before the cache goes cold; writes per-session JSON to ~/.claude/notch/sessions/.

mods.name: task-progress
mods.description: Registers a progress tool so Claude reports multi-step work, and draws a progress bar above the input box; writes per-session progress to ~/.claude/notch/sessions/.

mods.name: todo-pane
mods.description: /daiban side pane listing the in-progress and wrap-up items of a Markdown to-do log (NOTCH_TODO_LOG); writes ~/.claude/notch/todo.json.

mods.name: version-board
mods.description: /banben side pane of preview servers started by headless claude -p runs (port, effort level, done or running), using local lsof/ps; blocks opening more than 3 at once; writes ~/.claude/notch/versions.json.

mods.name: session-progress
mods.description: A pane for your Claude Code session: a plan bar for the current request, a history of every task with its steps and subagents, the live progress of a dev-loop orchestration run, and a pixel dragon that grows with your context window. A mod (function hooks); it reads and never writes to your project.

mods.name: clarity
mods.description: A clearer Claude Code terminal: boxed and organized you/claude conversations, colour-coded clickable tool rows, a live status band with a timer and task info, a session panel, copy buttons, cards, alerts, readable palettes, and overall transforms Claude Code.

mods.name: pending-changes
mods.description: Copilot-style review of the files Claude changes: a tree of changed files with +/- counts, accept/reject per file, folder or all, and a VS Code diff to revert single blocks.

mods.name: agent-mobile-observer
mods.description: 手機聊天室的觀測 mod：回合開始/結束與手機直送抵達，POST 給 :8899/api/observe；純觀測不改行為

mods.name: agent-mobile-perm
mods.description: 手機聊天室的授權卡 mod：桌面對話的 Bash 授權與選擇題同時送到手機，誰先按算誰；取代 settings.json 的 perm-bridge.js（mod 出錯時引擎自動退回它）

mods.name: rule-fairy
mods.description: Repository rules and docs, delivered to your coding agent. Injects Cursor-style rules into Claude Code sessions by prompt keyword, edited path, or alwaysApply, with documentation imports and reinjection after compaction.

mods.name: skill-navigator
mods.description: Picks the installed skill that fits each request, reading the recent conversation, and tells Claude to run it right away. /nav to inspect.

mods.name: clubhouse
mods.description: Claude Clubhouse: a toolbar above the prompt, rooms for usage, agents, commands, tool rules and colors, and whole-window themes on macOS

mods.name: ui-variants
mods.description: A live macOS picker window for Flutter UI variants: Claude writes the variants into a temporary app, and your choice, notes and revisions come back to the session

mods.name: lens
mods.description: Langfuse-lite for Claude Code — records load, usage, cache hits, turn scores and cost per session; /lens pane and prompt line; lens-review skill

mods.name: runtime
mods.description: harnist runtime mod — per-role subagent loading: trims skill list, MCP notes and CLAUDE.md per subagent type, enforces spawn rules and tool bans

mods.name: mission-control
mods.description: A live sidebar: project, context and quota, tasks, subagents with ETA, and a running recap

mods.name: cache-meter
mods.description: Prompt cache status above the prompt: how long the cache stays warm, what a re-cache would cost, plan limits near the cap. Keeps a big cache warm on request and asks before a cold send. The cache part of Nate Herk's cache-keeper.

mods.name: gate-meter
mods.description: Progress of the /unlazy gates bound to this session, one quiet row above the prompt: cells per gate or a pie, met of total, and its state: waiting for a decision, regressed, paused, abandoned, all met. /gates lists them all. Joins handoff-relay, cache-meter and next-steps in one band.

mods.name: handoff-relay
mods.description: A Handoff button above the prompt: runs /handoff and lights up from 180k tokens of context (the threshold option). Joins cache-meter and next-steps in one band.

mods.name: next-steps
mods.description: A What next? button above the prompt: on press, suggests up to three next prompts; 1, 2 or 3 puts one into the input box as a draft, 0 hides them. A fork of Thariq Shihipar's next-steps, which suggested after every turn.

mods.name: magic-router
mods.description: Routes each session to Sonnet 5.5 or Opus 5.5 and each prompt to an effort level, using a local GLiNER2.5 classifier

mods.name: helix-spinner
mods.description: Replaces the spinner row with a twisting braille helix, a wacky verb and the turn's time and tokens

mods.name: hudlite
mods.description: Lean claude-hud: clickable 5h / 7d / context, cache and cost rows. Multilingual (English, 繁中, 简中, 日本語...)

mods.name: dashband
mods.description: Prompt cache, context and plan limits at a glance, in the prompt footer and above the prompt

mods.name: codemode
mods.description: One codemode tool: the model writes a script that calls the session's tools, and only the script's output returns.

mods.name: usage-band
mods.description: Usage band above the prompt: limits with projection, context, tokens, speed, cost, turns, tools, churn, agents, model, effort, folder, git and memory, each one switchable

mods.name: live-status
mods.description: A live monitor for Claude Code: model, effort, context, 5h/7d usage limits, task progress and a subagents panel, in one responsive card.

mods.name: token-saver
mods.description: Keeps weekly token usage down (early compaction with a notes file, cheaper models, effort cap, subagent trimming, pacing note) and adds a usage bar with a settings menu above the prompt.

mods.name: jev-claude-router
mods.description: Routes each Claude Code turn to the model and effort TypeSafe's Jev picks, weighed against what a switch costs, and compacts with Jev instead of a lossy summary.

mods.name: spc
mods.description: Ostrakon v2: can a Client take keyboard focus without a click

mods.name: spx
mods.description: Ostrakon v2 platform experiments

mods.name: spx0
mods.description: P2 step 0: hidden action-layer buttons and edge sentinels

mods.name: spgallery
mods.description: Throwaway gallery: draws everything this Claude Code build can draw

mods.name: spmock
mods.description: Ostrakon v2 design mockups (phase D, part 2): static renders of every pane state

mods.name: session-handoff-button
mods.description: A Session Hand-off button above the prompt, colored by context usage; reads Context clean and cannot be pressed while green. From orange on, one press writes the handoff, saves it to a temp .md, clears the session and continues in the fresh one with a short message while the handoff goes in as hidd…

mods.name: jev-effort
mods.description: Sets the main conversation's reasoning effort per prompt with TypeSafe's Jev (via OpenRouter), reading recent conversation context. Shadow mode by default: logs what it would do without changing anything.

mods.name: skill-router
mods.description: On every prompt, asks Jev which skills fit, shows them ranked above the prompt, and passes them to the model as suggestions.

mods.name: en-cristiano
mods.description: Debajo de cada acción de Claude, una línea en español normal que explica qué está haciendo (leer, crear, mover, borrar, buscar...). Para entender a Claude sin saber informática.

mods.name: mejora-prompts
mods.description: /mejora y una frase: Claude te hace 3-5 preguntas, escribe un prompt con contexto (sin rol), lo puntúa y lo corrige hasta el 9/10, con bucle o sin bucle. Método de diariovida.com.

mods.name: mis-reglas
mods.description: Tu Claude se ve distinto: una franja encima del cuadro de texto con tus reglas activas y el «pensando» en español castizo.

mods.name: modo-grabacion
mods.description: Modo grabación: /grabar oculta en pantalla correos, rutas de usuario, IPs, claves y los nombres que tú elijas, para grabar sin enseñar datos

mods.name: papelera
mods.description: Cuando Claude va a borrar algo, en vez de borrarlo lo manda a una papelera (~/.papelera-claude) para que puedas recuperarlo. /papelera te enseña qué hay dentro.

mods.name: tiny-spec
mods.description: A tiny, opinionated spec-driven flow: scope/adopt → create → plan → build, with an independent reviewer per task, plus a live run view (/tiny-spec).

mods.name: pulseline
mods.description: High-performance statusline and above-the-prompt alert band for Claude Code, with setup commands and diagnostics

mods.name: installguard
mods.description: Looks up every new package before it installs: holds made-up names, typosquats, days-old releases and curl-into-shell for your answer, and lets the rest through.

mods.name: pin-message
mods.description: Pin selected text or Claude's last response to a side pane that stays visible while the conversation scrolls on

mods.name: session-identity
mods.description: free-agents: spinner words that name the model actually running a local / free-API session

mods.name: ci-line
mods.description: CI state of the current branch above the prompt: a line of checkpoints, branching into jobs when something runs or fails

mods.name: session-radar
mods.description: A live sidebar for long sessions: usage limits, context, agents, background shells and progress at a glance

mods.name: waiting-bell
mods.description: Rings a bell and shows a banner whenever Claude is blocked waiting for you, repeating every 5 minutes until you answer

mods.name: autopilot
mods.description: Picks the right model for each task, locks the model in long chats to keep the prompt cache, and shows live 5-hour and weekly usage above the prompt, runs a builder/tester/reviewer coding team (/team) and keeps a to-do list shared by all your chats (/todo). A ⚙ settings card turns each feature on o…

mods.name: redact-restore
mods.description: Reversible redaction for Claude Code: private values are replaced with placeholders before the model API sees them and restored locally. No API gateway.

mods.name: cache-watch
mods.description: A band above the prompt that counts down to your prompt cache expiring and shows what it costs your next message

mods.name: rainy-window
mods.description: A theme for the Claude desktop and mobile apps: Clawd's room on a rainy day, in halftone dots, with rain at the window, a record spinning, and Clawd typing at his desk

mods.name: assisted-by
mods.description: Writes Claude's commit and PR attribution as an Assisted-by trailer instead of Co-Authored-By, keeping the model name

mods.name: buddy
mods.description: A small companion above the prompt that thinks while Claude works, cheers when a turn lands, frets at a tool error and naps when left alone

mods.name: compact-diffs
mods.description: Draws one dim line ("Edited src/foo.ts (+3 -1)") in place of the inline diff under Edit and Write results; ctrl+o still shows the diff

mods.name: compact-tool
mods.description: Gives Claude a compact tool for interactive sessions, so an automated workflow can compact the conversation at a natural boundary (optionally only past a context threshold) and carry on, up to a set number of times per session

mods.name: effort-router
mods.description: Sets a turn's reasoning effort from an inline !low / !medium / !high / !xhigh / !max token or from keyword rules, and strips the token from the prompt

mods.name: idle-compact
mods.description: Compacts the conversation after a stretch of idle minutes, before the prompt cache expires, so the next prompt does not pay to rebuild it

mods.name: latex-unicode
mods.description: Draws the LaTeX math in Claude's replies ($...$ and $$...$$) as Unicode in the terminal: α, x², a/b, √x, ∑, ≤

mods.name: no-auto-plan
mods.description: Stops Claude from entering plan mode on its own; you can still enter it with shift+tab

mods.name: prefer-builtin-tools
mods.description: Turns back simple Bash commands (cat, head, tail, grep, rg, find, sed -i, echo > file) whose job Read, Grep, Glob, Edit or Write does better, naming the tool to use

mods.name: prompt-queue
mods.description: A /queue command: line up prompts that run one after another, each once the turn before it finishes

mods.name: session-namer
mods.description: Lets Claude rename its own session with a rename_session tool, and names an unnamed session after its first answer

mods.name: session-style
mods.description: Gives every session in a project the same prompt color and name prefix, from .claude/session-style.json or your defaults

mods.name: skill-blocklist
mods.description: Disables individual skills, plugin skills included: hidden from the model's skill listing and the typeahead, refused at the Skill tool, and never loaded

mods.name: skill-status
mods.description: Shows the skill the current turn is running in the status line under the prompt, cleared when the turn ends

mods.name: state-band
mods.description: One line above the prompt that says whether Claude is working, waiting on you, done (and when), or stopped on an error

mods.name: timestamps
mods.description: Shows the local time (HH:MM:SS) each user and assistant message was added, beside it in the transcript

mods.name: tool-group-names
mods.description: Names the files and patterns under folded tool lines like "Read 3 files"

mods.name: turn-word
mods.description: Replaces the rotating word in the turn's closing line (Baked, Brewed, Cogitated...) with one fixed word

mods.name: usage-meter
mods.description: A band above the prompt showing context fill, 5-hour and 7-day rate limits, and session cost

mods.name: voice-fixups
mods.description: Custom vocabulary for dictated prompts: replaces spoken phrases ("cube cuttle") with what you meant ("kubectl"), whole words, any case

mods.name: translate-for-claude
mods.description: Translate Chinese prompts to English before they reach Claude, and Claude's answers back to Chinese, with DeepSeek

mods.name: Cache
mods.description: Status line with the prompt-cache countdown and session cost

mods.name: shellcast
mods.description: Tidy one-line shell command rows with live output, progress, timing and exit status, plus details on demand.

mods.name: ask-form
mods.description: Draws Claude's questions as a step-by-step form: back/forward between questions, a recommended option first, and a free-text answer.

mods.name: dev-servers
mods.description: A Servers pane for this project's dev servers: what is listening, on which port, since when, with Start, Stop, Restart and Log buttons; names the process holding a port when a command fails with EADDRINUSE; a read-only dev_servers tool for Claude. Scans with netstat (never lsof), one session for al…

mods.name: docs-gardener
mods.description: Keeps a project's markdown true to the project: deterministic checks (dead references, stale TODOs, duplicated paragraphs, orphans, dated series, oversized files, finished plans) at write time and from a docs_check tool, and /docs audit, which adds a model edit plan you apply item by item from a pa…

mods.name: downloads-drop
mods.description: Notices files that land in Downloads while you work (PDFs, 3MF models, images, notes) and offers them in a band above the prompt: Attach puts @"path" mentions in the prompt box, Dismiss clears them. /downloads lists the newest files and attaches any by number. No model calls.

mods.name: effort-router
mods.description: Routes each turn's effort from your prompt: git housekeeping replies ("merged", "commit and push", "push it") run at low effort, deep asks (review, audit, plan, why does...) at max, everything else (approvals like "yes" or "continue" included) at the session's own. Switches only when the prompt cac…

mods.name: job-watch
mods.description: Live pane of long-running jobs (training, downloads, extractions) and the servers Claude starts: progress, ETA, stalls, exits and finishes, read from their logs with no model calls; jobs_list / jobs_watch / jobs_unwatch tools so Claude follows jobs instead of polling them.

mods.name: machine-guard
mods.description: Memory, swap, GPU and the CPU cores macOS is using on the status line, and a machine_status tool for Claude; refuses heavy local jobs (training, inference, rendering, Docker) while memory is critical or the Mac is reserved with /busy.

mods.name: mod-monitor
mods.description: Watches how your other mods really behave: hook failures and slow hooks (read off the chain's own trace), what each one did (toasts, status lines, commands, processes, model calls, writes), with /mods for a live pane and /mods report for the last day, week or month. mods.name: modal-meter

mods.name: pr-autopilot

mods.name: recall

mods.name: repo-brief
mods.description: Gathers the repo's state at session start (branch, ahead/behind, uncommitted work, recent commits, open PRs with CI, focus-label issues, stale branches) with no model calls, shows it in a band above the prompt and hands Claude the same summary in its first message.

mods.name: routine-watch

mods.name: constellation

mods.name: mod-logic

mods.name: spec-sharpener

mods.name: twins
mods.description: Tells you when two copies of something drift apart, and never edits anything itself. mods.name: ystack-setup

mods.name: ystack-stats
mods.description: /ystack-stats shows what ystack saves you, from your own logs: your last days of API calls re-priced under ystack's rules, and real usage per active hour before and after you installed it. '/ystack-stats share' prints a paste-ready summary with numbers only.

mods.name: cc-prompt-enhance-mod
mods.description: Enhance button above the prompt: Sonnet sharpens your draft using the recent conversation

mods.name: matlevering
mods.description: Shows the meny.no basket and the planned dinners in a pane, in the matlevering repo

mods.name: pokebuddy
mods.description: A Gen 1 Pokémon buddy above your prompt that levels up and evolves from real work.

mods.name: snitch

mods.name: spx-chart

mods.name: glitchdeck

mods.name: sysop
mods.description: A small, autonomous delivery toolkit: contract-first changes carried to a checked, independently reviewed, landed state, alone or as a parallel fleet across claude, agy and pi (free models included).

mods.name: cc-spell-check
mods.description: Live spell check for the Claude Code terminal: red underlines in the prompt box, suggestion band above it

mods.name: todo-list
mods.description: Plan trees written by Claude through a plan tool, shown in a pane and status line with live activity.

mods.name: chat-theme
mods.description: 내 메시지와 Claude 답변을 색 있는 제목 줄과 테두리로 감싸서 채팅처럼 보이게 합니다

mods.name: custom-sidebar

mods.name: waddle-duck

mods.name: cockpit

mods.name: fast-kev-compaction

mods.name: ditto

mods.name: handoff

mods.name: prompt-enhancer

mods.name: prompt-marks

mods.name: subway-video

mods.name: usage-awareness

mods.name: adyusuf
mods.description: Global working rules, software standards, operating modes, role agents and gate scripts under one namespace: /adyusuf:<name>. Installed from the adyusuf-marketplace (this repository's prod branch).

mods.name: mission-control
mods.description: Mission Control: your agent team at a glance. Live sub-agents with pixel-crab characters, delegations to Codex, agy, OpenCode and Claude, a board of GitHub issues or .ops tickets, a daily log with /standup and /ship, a plan-aware budget, and a status line above the prompt.

mods.name: agent-pulse

mods.name: arsenal

mods.name: token-limit

mods.description: /mutate runs a mutation test limited to the lines changed since HEAD: each small change to the code (a flipped comparison, && for ||, a constant) is run against the tests, and the ones the tests did not catch are listed

mods.name: negative-space
mods.description: When an edit adds authorization, input validation or error handling, lists the refusal, invalid-input, failure and boundary-value tests that no test touched this session covers yet; a band after the turn and /negative-space

mods.name: perf-delta
mods.description: /perf runs a benchmark command several times and compares it with its baseline (saved earlier, or a git ref run in a temporary worktree): median wall time, peak memory and the spread of the runs, and whether the difference is larger than the noise

mods.name: port-lantern
mods.description: Keeps track of the dev servers the session started: their URLs and ports from the server's own output, whether each still listens, and its latest log lines, in the status line and a /ports pane; a toast when one starts or stops

mods.name: pr-lamp
mods.description: The current branch's pull request as a lamp: checks, review, unresolved threads and what is left before it can merge, in the status line and a /pr pane; a toast when it changes, and red checks and new review comments fed to Claude beside the next prompt

mods.name: prompt-coach
mods.description: Holds back a typed prompt that looks ambiguous (no done-condition, unclear target) and offers guesses at what it meant, sending it as is, or adding one; on by default

mods.name: sandbox-lens
mods.description: Tallies sandbox denials seen in Bash output and reports them with /sandbox-report

mods.name: self-audit
mods.description: After each turn, a cached fork of the conversation audits Claude's own reply against the CLAUDE.md reporting rules and flags violations above the prompt

mods.name: side-effect-ledger
mods.description: A ledger of what a git diff never shows: pushes, publishes, deploys, pull requests, releases, API writes and messages sent, each with its outcome, how it would be undone, and whether that undo has been checked; /ledger

mods.name: stack-dock
mods.description: The repository's devrouter stack in one press: the band above the prompt says whether it is unset, stopped or up, starts it with devrouter up, shows each service's URL and health in the status line and a /stack pane, and puts doctor's findings and the failing logs into the prompt for Claude to fix…

mods.name: todo-agent
mods.description: Collects #TODO(agent) follow-ups from Claude's replies into a per-project list with a /todos pane.

mods.name: token-lens
mods.description: Checks a page element's actual colours, spacing and type against the project's registered design tokens (CSS custom properties, SCSS variables, tokens JSON): /token-lens <selector>, or the text selected in the browser, lists each value as a token or an off-token value with the nearest token

mods.name: tool-row
mods.description: Redraws finished tool-call rows in the terminal as one compact line with a Nerd Font icon, Gruvbox colors and a short stat

mods.name: visual-diff
mods.description: Compares the browser screenshots Claude takes of the same URL at the same size, before and after an edit: both side by side, a map of the cells that changed, the changed regions in page pixels and the files edited in between; /vdiff

mods.name: zukan
mods.description: Error book: catches the errors Bash commands hit across sessions and repos, records what got past each one, and when one comes back tells Claude and the person how it was fixed last time

mods.name: sintese-playmaker
mods.description: Notices when there is enough parallelizable work, offers to run it with the agent CLIs you already have installed (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini/Antigravity, Copilot), and coordinates the workers through git worktrees and Lore. Commands to plan, run, review, merge, retry, stop and check a parallel run.

mods.name: segue
mods.description: Compaction that continues without a break: writes a handoff card before /compact and auto-compact, summarises on Haiku, and tells the agent to carry on from the card. Falls back to the built-in summary on any failure.

mods.name: backlog-band
mods.description: Shows the active project's BACKLOG.md Now items above the prompt; /later adds to Next

mods.name: commit-drift
mods.description: Uncommitted files and time since last commit in the status line, with a nudge after editing turns

mods.name: commonplace-pane
mods.description: A docked pane of public-domain paintings (Art Institute of Chicago) whose weather follows the repo: calm when clean, stormy when it isn't

mods.name: day-recap
mods.description: Writes a short recap of what you did when you step away, and shows it above the prompt when you come back

mods.name: quest-board
mods.description: Three daily quests from the repo's TODOs, open issues and failing tests, in a pane, with a toast for each one cleared

mods.name: radio
mods.description: Internet radio in Claude Code: /tune streams SomaFM, lo-fi and classical through one player shared by every session, with controls above the prompt

mods.name: spend-meter
mods.description: Session cost, context fill and 5h rate-limit use in the status line

mods.name: mission-control
mods.description: Progress bar above the prompt, a live helper-agents pane, and an All chats pane showing what every chat is doing

mods.name: notch-hud
mods.description: A Dynamic Island-style HUD around the MacBook notch for Claude Code: session progress at a glance, answer questions and permission requests without going back to the terminal. macOS 15+ on Apple Silicon.

mods.name: red-pen
mods.description: 红笔批阅：在 Claude 的回答上逐段批「采纳 / 不要 / 啥意思 / 批注」，一键拼成「原文——批注」发出；长回答自动按规矩批一遍，问过的词记进看不懂词典

mods.name: skill-suggester
mods.description: Suggests one of your skills from what you are working on: your message, the last few turns, the files Claude reads and writes, project hints and your past clicks. Local BM25 over each SKILL.md; no model calls, no tokens until you click.

mods.name: rtl-text
mods.description: Right-to-left (RTL) text for Claude Code: shows Persian (Farsi), Arabic and Hebrew paragraphs in the right order, with mixed English, numbers and punctuation where they belong

mods.name: pomodoro
mods.description: Button-first Pomodoro timer above the Claude Code prompt: one-click focus blocks, a live countdown band, break reminders and a config pane.

mods.name: dev-deck-mod
mods.description: Your Claude Code CLI sessions in a pane: what's open and what it runs, the past ones to resume, your messages as chapters, and a guard against a second dev server. Windows.

mods.name: auto-handoff
mods.description: Hands the work to a fresh, named session when the context gets too full, using your /handoff command

mods.name: blocked-run
mods.description: When auto mode blocks a command, or Claude asks you to run one, shows it above the prompt with a button to run it yourself

mods.name: branch-status
mods.description: A small git-flow graph of main, develop and your branch, with what is waiting to release

mods.name: handoff-pickup
mods.description: Picks up your newest handoff with /pickup, and deletes it when you're done

mods.name: spectree
mods.description: A runtime that refuses to call work done until a command proves it: evidence bound to a content digest, isolated adversarial QA, a post-merge receipt and only three human gates. An agent squad for Claude Code and Codex, built for spec-driven modular monoliths.

mods.name: session-status
mods.description: Band above the prompt: prompt-cache countdown, context fill, session cost, usage limits and a Compact button.

mods.name: aside
mods.description: Read-only side chat: /aside opens a pane beside the transcript where you ask about the session so far; answers come from a tool-less fork of the session's own transcript and nothing is written back into the main thread.

mods.name: changes
mods.description: /changes: the session's edits grouped by concept, then files, then the exact code; point at lines and ask Claude about them or have it change them

mods.name: find-sess
mods.description: /find-sess <what you remember>: find a past session in this repo with a Haiku call, then resume it

mods.name: goal-meter
mods.description: Live overall-goal progress bar above the prompt, from the task tools plus Claude's per-turn goal estimate

mods.name: insight-pane
mods.description: Live pane of the decisions, root causes and gotchas worth knowing, fed into ~/learning notes

mods.name: live-progress
mods.description: Live progress bands above the prompt for long-running work Claude starts: tests, builds, scripts, logs

mods.name: lumen
mods.description: Colourful, themeable rendering for Claude Code replies, with animated diagrams, timelines, state machines and sparklines. A fork of prismantis.

mods.name: mcp-control
mods.description: Lets Claude see every configured MCP server, ask you (one click) to enable one that is off here, and reconnect a server after editing it

mods.name: self-drive
mods.description: /self-drive: hand Claude a task and walk away; it decides alone, logs every call it would have asked you, holds risky actions, and keeps going

mods.name: session-namer
mods.description: Gives each session a short findable name on exit, and re-checks it on later exits

mods.name: skills
mods.description: /skills: per-prompt skill suggestions, what Claude actually loaded, and one-key use of a suggested skill

mods.name: gate-board
mods.description: A /gate pane: open PRs with checks and panel status, what main has that Supabase isn't running, and merges since the last Lovable publish

mods.name: remote-control-toggle
mods.description: Shows whether Remote Control is on, in the prompt footer (or a band with a toggle button)

mods.name: voice-check
mods.description: Holds Notion writes that contain meta commentary and sends them back to Claude to rewrite

mods.name: usage-tracker
mods.description: Shows 5-hour and weekly plan usage and the context window above the prompt

mods.name: agent-radar
mods.description: One live line above the prompt per running subagent: time, tool count and what it's doing. /radar shows every agent and its messages.

mods.name: install-preflight
mods.description: /preflight <folder | owner/repo | git url> shows, in plain language, what a plugin or mod can do before you install it, with the raw hooks: and calls: lines as the authority.

mods.name: lookout
mods.description: A second pair of eyes while Claude works. Every few model steps it asks one tool-less fork of the session (served from the prompt cache) whether there is something you should know and might miss, and shows the answer above the prompt. No model call while nothing draws the session.

mods.name: loop-breaker
mods.description: Stops Claude repeating the same failing tool call. Counts identical calls that error or are refused, hints after the second, refuses the next after the threshold with a reason Claude can act on, and shows a worsening face above the prompt with a one-key Stop and rethink.

mods.name: read-ceiling-pager
mods.description: A Read whose window would exceed Claude Code's token cap is clamped to the lines that fit, and the result says where to continue. Turns a failed round into a successful partial read with an explicit continuation.

mods.name: reminder-diet
mods.description: Leaves out a task reminder that repeats, word for word, the last one the same loop was sent. The model already has that copy in its context; the repeat only fills the window and brings the next compaction sooner.

mods.name: x-mcp-budget
mods.description: Caps what Claude's X (Twitter) MCP reads cost. List, search and timeline calls ask for at most 10 results, every post and user returned is priced and counted once per UTC day, and once the day's estimate reaches the budget further X MCP calls are refused until midnight UTC.

mods.name: effort-guard
mods.description: Claude Code mod: context/token band, escalation signals and per-turn effort log.

mods.name: auto-voice
mods.description: Reads Claude Code's replies aloud as they appear, section by section, with a small player bar: mute, skip, pause and natural voices.

mods.name: wordle-mod
mods.description: Play a Wordle-style game in a pane while Claude generates a response.

mods.name: last-call
mods.description: Stops work at a clean point before the 5-hour (or 7-day) usage limit, keeps the prompt cache warm while waiting, and continues the work after the reset.

mods.name: lessons-learned
mods.description: Learns from your corrections: keeps each one for you to confirm at session start, recalls the lesson when it is relevant again, and turns a repeated correction into a rule CLAUDE.md loads in every session.

mods.name: ctx-guard
mods.description: Configurable context and usage guard: per-role notes, tool blocks, guarded handoff with clear-and-resume or compact, and subagent context budgets.

mods.name: limit-dzienny
mods.description: Dzieli tygodniowy limit na 7 dni: ile z dzisiejszej 1/7 już zjedzone, zapas z poprzednich dni i ostrzeżenia przy 80% i 100% dnia

mods.name: pasek
mods.description: Pasek nad promptem: repo, branch, koszt, kontekst, limity 5h, dzienny (z modem limit-dzienny) i tygodniowy, licznik ciepłego cache, przyciski REC i Handoff

mods.name: record-mode
mods.description: /record on zasłania na ekranie maile, klucze API, kwoty i ścieżki domowe; model dalej widzi prawdziwy tekst

mods.name: tetris
mods.description: /tetris otwiera Tetrisa w panelu obok, gdy Claude pracuje; rekord zostaje między sesjami

mods.name: wytlumacz-mi
mods.description: Tłumaczy po polsku, co Claude właśnie zrobił (krótko, od konkretu, z jednym „dlaczego”), i streszcza rozmowę po powrocie do sesji. Każde kliknięcie to zapytanie do modelu. Na bazie Explain It (MIT)

mods.name: right-tool
mods.description: Shows your most used skills and slash commands in a band above the prompt while you type /. Type a digit from 1 to 5 to insert one.

mods.name: git-casino
mods.description: Every git commit spins a slot machine; a clean commit pays double and green CI on the first try hits the jackpot

mods.name: read-aloud
mods.description: Reads Claude's replies and your prompts aloud on request, with the open-source Kokoro TTS model.

mods.name: dev-dashboard
mods.description: Pane showing Claude service status, unpushed local repos, recent commits and GitHub pushes

mods.name: usage-limits
mods.description: One line above the prompt: context window fill, the five-hour session limit and the weekly limit, with bars and the time left until each limit resets.

mods.name: chiikawa
mods.description: Chiikawa mode: Hachiware conducts, and the friends from Chiikawa appear as text drawings to take on tasks and talk them over (Claude subagents + Orca workers). In English, Korean and Japanese.

mods.name: terminal-polish
mods.description: Status band, sessions sidebar, activity dashboard, prompt cards, command guard and turn notifications for Claude Code

mods.name: attachments
mods.description: The draft's attachments as chips above the prompt: each pasted picture, pasted text, @-mentioned file or folder and, with the issues mod, @# issue, with a glyph for its type, its path and what it is, and a × to take it out of the draft.

mods.name: issues
mods.description: Finds the repository's GitHub issues as @# is typed in the prompt, as opencode.vim does: a list above the prompt filtered by number or title, picked with a click or Ctrl+X Tab, and each @#N sent with the issue for the model to read.

mods.name: statusline
mods.description: A vim-style status bar in the Claude Code footer: editor mode, permission mode, model, effort, git state, usage and cursor; numbers the draft's lines and keeps the prompt box taller.

mods.name: stfu
mods.description: Drops the whimsical word from the line that runs while Claude works and from the one that closes a turn, leaving the elapsed time, tokens and duration where Claude Code draws them.

mods.name: syntax
mods.description: Colors the prompt's draft as it is typed: its markdown, the code in its fences, and in shell mode the command.

mods.name: vim
mods.description: A vim command line for Claude Code: :w and :e keep a draft per session, :q quits (! to force), and any other name runs that slash command, with Tab completion. Opened by the focus chord for the area above the prompt; drawn in the statusline mod's bar.

mods.name: mize-coworker
mods.description: Claude as a small coworker in the terminal: an orange pixel-art Claude, two rows tall, in 132 frames. While a turn runs he sits beside the spinner in a scene for every spinner word (a thought bubble, a pen on a notepad, a book, a magnifying glass over text or over a globe, a laptop, a terminal, his…

mods.name: agent-watch
mods.description: Agent Watch: one pane for every Claude Code session on your machine and its subagents, running, waiting for you, or idle

mods.name: subagent-monitor
mods.description: Animated sidebar of your subagents: progress, time, tokens and cost, with model switching and messages

mods.name: coaster-tycoon
mods.description: A RollerCoaster Tycoon-style park that Claude builds while it works: tool calls lay track, coasters get test runs, crowds pour in, and parks compete on a global leaderboard.

mods.name: wrap-it-up-auto
mods.description: Logs durable decisions, lessons, and action items to wrap-it-up's .claude-brain as they're confirmed in conversation, instead of only at /wrap-it-up.

mods.name: autotune
mods.description: Reviews each finished response in the background and records evidence for tested harness improvements

mods.name: session-activity
mods.description: Chips above the prompt for each skill, subagent, MCP server, permission decision, hook and rule that activated this session. Press one to see why.

mods.name: dispatch-panel
mods.description: A side panel listing dispatched agents and background shells, with purpose, tokens and duration

mods.name: herdr-claude-restart
mods.description: /restart exits Claude Code and relaunches it on the same session inside the same herdr pane.

mods.name: afk-timer
mods.description: Shows how long you have been away from a Claude Code session and warns when its prompt cache has likely expired, so you can /clear instead of paying to re-read a big conversation

mods.name: diagrams
mods.description: Pins the diagrams Claude draws to a chip above the prompt: expand it in place, open it full screen or in the browser, and see it as a rendered picture

mods.name: color-on-start
mods.description: 新しいセッションが始まるときに /color を実行して、プロンプトバーの色を変える。

mods.name: pet-bridge
mods.description: Forwards live session activity (thinking, tools, permissions, answers) to the ClaudePet desktop pet.

mods.name: prompt-forge
mods.description: Spends your Claude Code tokens where they count: moves a new task into a fresh session (a new terminal window, or its own git worktree) instead of dragging a long conversation along, and runs small, clear tasks on Sonnet.

mods.name: session-stats
mods.description: /session-stats opens a live pane with CPU, RAM and the process tree of this Claude session

mods.name: next-steps-appcard
mods.description: After each turn, suggests up to three next prompts in a card above the input: a What next? title row with a collapse toggle and a close button, and a small card per suggestion. Click a suggestion's label to put its prompt in the input box as a draft you can edit. Starts collapsed.

mods.name: next-steps-askcard
mods.description: As each turn ends, suggests up to three next prompts in the question card. Pick one (or type your own) and it lands in the input box as a draft you can edit. The turn waits for the card, so it ends once you answer or close it.

mods.name: commit-msg
mods.description: Writes an accurate conventional commit message for your staged changes, using the Claude session that made them to explain why. Matches your repo's commit style; edit, regenerate and copy it from a pane. /commit-msg [simple|body|full] [note].

mods.name: laravel-tooling
mods.description: Runs Pint and Larastan after Claude edits PHP, and Pest or PHPUnit on demand, then shows the results in a live pane and the status line. /laravel-tooling opens the pane, /laravel-tooling run checks everything, /laravel-tooling tests [filter] runs the tests.

mods.name: proofread
mods.description: Fixes spelling and grammar in your prompt before it reaches Claude, and draws your prompts in a highlighted box with the fixed words called out. /proofread turns it on or off.

mods.name: work-journal
mods.description: Daily, weekly and monthly reviews of your work in Claude Code, summarized from the prompts you typed: projects, threads, decisions and open items. /journal opens it in a pane, /journal web as a webpage.

mods.name: whoami
mods.description: Claude Code mod: shows which Claude account, organization and plan the session uses and how much of the usage limit is left, and holds prompts in a folder pinned to another account.

mods.name: effort-router
mods.description: Picks the reasoning effort for each turn of the main conversation with a System One classifier (hosted Jev or a compatible service) and shows the level on the spinner and on the line that closes the turn. In shadow mode it shows and logs its pick and sends the session's effort; in enforce mode it s…

mods.name: token-weather
mods.description: A live forecast of the context window and the 5-hour and weekly quota, drawn above the prompt.

mods.name: cc-autocompact
mods.description: Auto-compact when the task ends, not when the context window is full. The model ends a task with 'Ready to compact.' and the plugin runs /compact, saves the summary and puts the handoff back. From 200k it asks the model whether the task is closed. Adds /compact-now and /cc-doctor.

mods.name: links-bar
mods.description: A links bar above the prompt in Claude Desktop's Code tab: up to 4 pinned links per project or session with favicons, the session's 10 latest links, and a pane of every pinned link. Reads the session transcript; asks a link's own site for its page title and favicon (curl for PNG and ICO icons); ope…

mods.name: overalls
mods.description: Status band above the prompt: context weather, usage limits, and the Ponytail and Caveman levels

mods.name: neo4j-memory
mods.description: Persistent memory for Claude Code in a local SQLite file (node:sqlite; no server, no container). Injects standing facts and a subsystem map at session start, captures new facts at compaction and session end, and exposes search tools. A machine's Neo4j graph moves across by itself on first start.

mods.name: account-swap
mods.description: Switch between saved Claude accounts from inside Claude Code, and auto-swap before the active one hits its rate limit.

mods.name: burn-rate
mods.description: A terminal cost dashboard (/burn): spend by day, project, model, activity, tools, shell commands and MCP servers, read from your local Claude Code transcripts and estimated at list price.

mods.name: context-gauge
mods.description: A band above the prompt showing how full the context window is, shading green → orange → red, with a nudge to /compact as it nears the limit.

mods.name: model-router
mods.description: Routes each turn to the cheapest model + effort that fits the task (Haiku 5.5 → Sonnet 5.5 → Opus 5.5 → Fable 5.2 or 5.1) and shows the ladder in a side pane.

mods.name: ping
mods.description: Plays a chime and shows a toast when a long turn finishes (or Claude is waiting on your approval), so you can walk away.

mods.name: safety-net
mods.description: Blocks destructive tool calls before they run (force pushes, rm -rf outside the project, DROP TABLE, terraform destroy, writes to .env and keys, ...) and explains why.

mods.name: secret-scrubber
mods.description: Redacts API keys, tokens, private keys and .env secrets from tool output before the transcript stores it and before the model reads it.

mods.name: session-graph
mods.description: A knowledge graph across your Claude Code sessions. Each session records its topics and files; when another session covers the same ground you get an alert, and /graph can pull its findings into the one you are in.

mods.name: standup
mods.description: /standup: click Generate and get a written standup of everything you got done today, grouped by project, from your local Claude Code sessions.

mods.name: stock-watch
mods.description: /stock: watch tickers and get a chime when one reaches the low or high you set. Works any time, in any session.

mods.name: turn-recap
mods.description: Adds a one-line TL;DR beneath long answers, written by a quick Haiku 5.5 call.

mods.name: usage-meter
mods.description: 在提示框上方顯示模型、context、5h／7d 額度、快取與花費

mods.name: cost-bar
mods.description: /spend toggles a band above the prompt with live API-equivalent spend per model, cache state, context and a next-prompt estimate.

mods.name: colony-code
mods.description: Shows this Claude Code session and its subagents as remote workers in your RimWorld colony (needs the Colony Code mod running in the game).

mods.name: teams
mods.description: Turn on a team of agents (a lead and specialists) with /team, with a live pane showing the plan, who is doing what, what needs you, and a log, plus guardrails on what helpers can do.

mods.name: auto-compact
mods.description: Auto-compacts an idle Claude Code conversation shortly before the prompt cache expires, so the next summarization request warms the cache instead of reprocessing the full history.

mods.name: session-monitor
mods.description: A side panel of all your open Claude Code sessions: what each one is doing, live, with a pixel creature per session.

mods.name: learn-trail
mods.description: 설명의 목차·현재 위치·곁가지를 패널에 띄우고, 항목별 설명을 저장해 /recall 로 그대로 다시 본다

mods.name: jevshift
mods.description: Experimental Jev-assisted model and effort selection for Claude Code: observe, pin, off, and opt-in auto.

mods.name: agent-skills
mods.description: Serves skills from .agents/skills (project and home) and Moxen's bundled skills to Claude Code, without copying them into .claude/skills.

mods.name: act-now-guard
mods.description: 計画フェーズの要らない依頼で EnterPlanMode や Plan エージェントに入ろうとしたら止め、すぐ実装に着手させる function hook

mods.name: advanced-rust-cli
mods.description: Rustで実装された基礎的なコマンドの改善版のみを常に使用するように挙動を変更するMod

mods.name: agent-router
mods.description: サブエージェントと Workflow の agent() の依頼を LocalJev でロールに分類し、agent-routing の roles.json に従って model と effort を切り替える function hook

mods.name: approval-guard
mods.description: AskUserQuestion で得た承認と gh の不可逆コマンド（レビュー投稿・close・merge）の宛先を照合し、force push の確認と PR 本文の Closes キーワードの確認も行う function hook

mods.name: auto-compact
mods.description: ターン終了時のコンテキスト使用率・ターン数、またはプロンプトキャッシュの失効を見て自動で Compaction し、要約をテキストに保存する。終了前の Issue 化・ドキュメント化を Agent に義務づけ、会話には何をやったか・何ができたか・次に何をやるかだけを残す

mods.name: bash-hints
mods.description: Bash の呼び出しに専用ツールへの誘導・rust-parallel・mise exec・pueue デーモンのヒントを足し、長い sleep を止める function hook

mods.name: change-review
mods.description: 実装後の差分を、実装者とは別の読み取り専用レビュアー SubAgent に点検させるMod。指摘の形式検証、再レビュー回数の上限、未実施・未解決の明示を行う。任意で、ローカルLLMによる差分の一次点検 (参考データ) も提供する

mods.name: code-finder
