mods.name: usage-pacer
mods.description: Shows session-limit usage in the status line, warns once at 80% and 95% of each window, and can run a /handoff command before the 5h limit in the session you are working in

mods.name: react-native-code-guardian
mods.description: Guards Expo / React Native work in Claude Code: blocks explicit `any` and non-Expo package installs, warns on TanStack Query, UI, architecture and duplication issues, and adds a /check command.

mods.name: leviro-agent-watcher
mods.description: Side pane with the 5-hour and weekly limits of Claude, Codex, Antigravity and Grok, running delegate relays, the plan, and desktop, ntfy and Telegram alerts

mods.name: env-guard
mods.description: Claude Code mod: blocks Claude from reading .env secret files and counts blocked attempts in the status line

mods.name: script-gate
mods.description: Claude Code mod: blocks running scripts straight from the internet (download-and-execute pipes, encoded PowerShell, LOLBin downloads)

mods.name: cache-clock
mods.description: A one-line band above the prompt: context used, and a countdown until the prompt cache goes cold

mods.name: decision-tree
mods.description: When Claude ends a reply with a question, explains the choice in a side pane and lets you explore any option, or your own, in a real forked session

mods.name: dream-pass
mods.description: A dreaming pass over Claude's memory folder: merges duplicates, rewrites stale entries, removes dead ones and tidies MEMORY.md, with a backup and undo

mods.name: jev-skill-suggestion
mods.description: Scores every skill against your prompt with TypeSafe Jev as you type; observe, block or steer skill loading

mods.name: memory-fork
mods.description: After each turn Haiku decides whether memory needs a change; a tool-less fork of the session drafts it and the mod writes it, with a band and a pane showing what changed

mods.name: secret-box
mods.description: Claude can use a secret without seeing it: a masked box saves keys to .env and gives Claude a placeholder, every key a tool prints comes back as a placeholder, and committing .env is refused

mods.name: vercel-deploy-status
mods.description: Pins the Vercel deploy queue of the linked project under the prompt: every deploy queued, building or just finished, with its phase and elapsed time

mods.name: git-graph
mods.description: A pane that draws the commit graph of a local git repo, and a Portfolio pane with one activity card per local project

mods.name: prompt-master
mods.description: Promote master: one click rewrites the rough prompt in your prompt box into a clearer one before you send it.

mods.name: statusbar
mods.description: One thin row above the prompt: context, rate limit, prompt-cache countdown, account, repo, branch, PR and CI

mods.name: dog-factory
mods.description: A pane of cute animated dogs working a factory: open asks, next steps, and work shipped by agents.

mods.name: obsidian-brain
mods.description: Persistent brain for Claude Code sessions using Obsidian. Auto-logs sessions, captures curated insights, enables project-scoped context resume, and provides fast cross-project search via tags and metadata.

mods.name: browser-guard
mods.description: Stops Chrome actions when the Chrome profile is not the one paired with the active cswap account

mods.name: herdr-fleet
mods.description: Pane: every herdr agent, its status and last words, with this pane marked

mods.name: on-me
mods.description: Band: what waits on you and what Claude is doing now

mods.name: ship-state
mods.description: Pane: uncommitted, unpushed, CI and deploy state of each repo this session touched

mods.name: twin-meter
mods.description: 5h and 7d limits of both cswap accounts in the band above the prompt

mods.name: al-syntax
mods.description: Tree-sitter syntax highlighting for AL (Business Central) code blocks in Claude's replies

mods.name: file-preview
mods.description: Click a markdown, JSON or YAML file link in a reply to preview it in a side pane, drawn like a docs page

mods.name: agent-panel
mods.description: Always-on activity panel (/subagents): tasks, background jobs, agents, assumptions and a live file tree; a progress band above the prompt.

mods.name: assumption-log
mods.description: Claude logs each assumption it makes mid-task; a side pane lists them so you can mark them right or wrong, or ask for a change.

mods.name: debug-on-paste
mods.description: When a pasted message looks like an error or stack trace, tells Claude to use systematic debugging.

mods.name: format-on-edit
mods.description: After each edit, runs the project's own formatter on that file: Prettier, dart format or Spotless, only where the project already has it.

mods.name: limit-guard
mods.description: Warns as the 5-hour limit fills and asks before subagents when it is nearly spent.

mods.name: progress-guard
mods.description: Nudges Claude to keep the progress task list updated: reminders after 3 tool calls without an update, and a toast when a turn ends with the list open.

mods.name: prompt-deck
mods.description: Band above the prompt: usage, prompt-cache countdown with compact warning, git health, next-prompt suggestion; /limits pane.

mods.name: prompt-queue
mods.description: Queue prompt ideas while Claude works (/add-queue), then send, modify or discard them from a side pane.

mods.name: push-preflight
mods.description: Before git push, runs the repo's format:check, lint and typecheck scripts and blocks the push if one fails.

mods.name: safety-guard
mods.description: Asks before force pushes, pushes and merges into main, PR merges, rm -rf, hard resets, DROP statements, flyway clean and .env writes.

mods.name: turn-meter
mods.description: Each turn's duration, tool calls and cost, shown in the prompt-deck band; a toast when a turn costs far more than usual.

mods.name: venv-auto
mods.description: Activates the nearest .venv for python, pip, pytest and jupyter commands, in Bash and PowerShell, so Claude never has to.

mods.name: waitlight
mods.description: See which of your other Claude Code sessions is waiting on you, from the one you're typing in: one line above the prompt, approvals first. Silent until something matters. Fully local.

mods.name: ops-pane
mods.description: Observe-only ops pane: files touched, recent tool calls, subagents, context and tokens; /ops toggles it, /ops-export writes the tool-call ledger as JSONL.

mods.name: limit-band
mods.description: Строка над полем ввода: сколько осталось лимита и когда платить за подписку

mods.name: gitlogue
mods.description: Watch Claude work: a gitlogue-style pane that replays its edits as live typing, reads code with a highlighter, searches, browses, runs commands and commits, beside a phone-style chat.

mods.name: agent-guard
mods.description: 派子 agent 的守卫(0.2.0 起也拦子 agent 在主 worktree 里的 git 写):拒 isolation worktree(会共用目录);声明的 WORKTREE 必须是独立、干净、没派过的 git worktree;写代码的仓库要求非只读子 agent 必须带 WORKTREE 行;0.3.2 起(G-R):配置仓库的主 worktree 里 git merge 碰敏感路径的分支,要有最新判词 SHIP / MERGE;0.3.9 起(S9):specGateRepos 里合 omdl/* 分支,要有一份绑到同一个被审提交的规格判词(spec-verdict.json…

mods.name: board
mods.description: 进度板:/board 一屏看当前仓的下一步 · GOAL 勾选 · 待拍板 · TODO · roadmap 在进行项 · 在跑的片 · 最近提交;/board myapp 看别的仓,/board all 各仓摘要。纯读文件,不调模型

mods.name: cache-clock
mods.description: 缓存钟:每次回复后在输入框上方倒数到 prompt cache 变冷,标出现在回复与冷了重写各要多少钱;冷了先拦一次人发的消息并报价,大会话给「交接」按钮(填入 /relay go);保温只在按按钮或 /keepwarm 时发。取代 cache-tax,底子是 benai cache-clock

mods.name: copy-lint
mods.description: MyApp 对外文案写入后自动查禁用词、标题句号和已废的片尾句,把命中提示给模型(不拦写入)

mods.name: cue
mods.description: 提词:每次回答后,站在你的位置写好下一条完整 prompt;终端里空输入框按 1 或点 Enhance 写进草稿(不发送),手机上弹窗让你选 发送 / 方向 B / 改写 / 放弃。/enhance 把你的粗稿改写成完整结构

mods.name: delegate
mods.description: lead 的外部 run 驾驶舱:扫描本会话的 omd-lite run($.delegate.runs)、守 launch(任务书 C-1b · 缺已重算/对外签名/安全面/不许交出去的内容 · 允许改动不重叠 · 起片间隔 · 磁盘预算)、把 --gate 包进按内存排队的 gate-slot.sh、run 结束合成一条叫醒、合并后清 worktree。不切片、不写任务书、不选执行器。

mods.name: prompt-guard
mods.description: 拦下 prompt 里的密钥 / 密码(放回去掉密钥的文本),并丢掉几分钟内重复发送的同一条消息

mods.name: relay
mods.description: 接力:/goal 把一句话写成 GOAL.md 并按 RELAY 行自动续跑到验收命令全过或真 owner 岔口才停;按 phase 切 effort;上下文到阈值自动交接并 /clear(GOAL / 定时期间跟在下一条干活 prompt 上;平时答完安静 30 秒后自己交接),带原文旁车,新会话先逐字贴回 clear 前没看到的回答;/relay go 手动交接;/handoff 写一份可分享的交接不清空;D 盘提醒和 /ops

mods.name: savvy-progress
mods.description: Fork of johnnyvizz/claude-kit savvy-progress 1.2.0: the /savvy-flow bar and /agents-info panel, plus omd-lite runs this session launched (mcode / claude -p / pi) with a pixel MiniMax.

mods.name: code-tutor
mods.description: Tutor de aprendizaje: explica el porqué de cada cambio de código en un panel propio y responde preguntas con /tutor

mods.name: productivity-hud
mods.description: HUD de productividad: contexto, costo, burn-rate y presupuesto de la sesión, sobre el prompt y en un panel.

mods.name: danger-check
mods.description: Asks you before a command that can destroy work, such as rm -rf, git reset --hard or git push --force.

mods.name: done-sound
mods.description: Plays a sound, picked by chance from the ones you chose, when a long turn ends and when Claude waits for your answer.

mods.name: mod-lab
mods.description: Shows what mods can do: a live list of events, a dump of what a mod can read, and demos you run with one press.

mods.name: no-new-branch
mods.description: Asks you before any command that would create a new git branch or worktree.

mods.name: no-process-kill
mods.description: Asks you before any command that would stop a running process.

mods.name: pnpm-only
mods.description: Blocks npm and npx commands and tells Claude the pnpm command to use instead.

mods.name: prompt-snippets
mods.description: Replaces short names such as ;plan in your prompt with longer texts that you saved.

mods.name: usage-line
mods.description: Shows live session cost, context use, and the 5-hour and weekly limits with their pace in one line above the prompt.

mods.name: usage-band
mods.description: Live 5h / 7d usage limits and context fill in a band above the prompt, with toasts at 80% and 90%

mods.name: dreeft
mods.description: Band above the prompt showing what the session's thinking is doing: focus, a turn timeline, and turn cost

mods.name: actera
mods.description: Check every Claude Code tool call against your Actera policies, hold risky calls for approval, and record what happened

mods.name: adaflow-governance
mods.description: Trilha de auditoria do Claude Code no Adaflow: /adaflow login (device flow) e envio em lote so de metadados (sessao, turno, ferramenta negada)

mods.name: adaflow-guard
mods.description: Guardrail para apps integrados ao Adaflow: impede vazar o app token (x-ada-token) para o browser, para o codigo-fonte ou para o transcript

mods.name: model-router
mods.description: Classifica cada prompt via Vercel AI Gateway e roteia o turno para haiku, sonnet ou opus; /router fixa um tier

mods.name: cache-magic
mods.description: Keeps a handoff while a large session's prompt cache is still warm. On a five-minute cache, a late prompt can go out after the handoff instead of the full context. On a one-hour cache the session stays, and compaction is pointed at the handoff.

mods.name: minecraft
mods.description: Playable first-person voxel sandbox inside Claude Code. Mine, build, explore, and save your world.

mods.name: gh-issue-links
mods.description: Turns GitHub issue and PR references in replies into links labelled repo#N (title), with a status and labels card on click

mods.name: status-band
mods.description: A band above the prompt with folder, git branch, model and effort, and colored meters for context and the 5-hour and weekly limits

mods.name: approve-blocked
mods.description: Retries an auto-mode-blocked call up to three times so Claude Code's own permission prompt (and Moshi) can ask you.

mods.name: left-undone
mods.description: A sidebar listing todos Claude left undone; press a letter to flag one, then send Claude back to finish it.

mods.name: chatroom
mods.description: One public, unmoderated chat room for everyone with this mod. It shows on the right of the screen while Claude works and hides when Claude waits for you. Messages go to a chat server; nothing from the room reaches Claude.

mods.name: ap-toolkit
mods.description: A clickable panel above the prompt: model, effort, helpers, Clean View, launch buttons, and Help, plus a status row and Today's report.

mods.name: usage-meter
mods.description: Rate-limit bars with live reset countdowns, session cost and today's cost above the prompt

mods.name: codex-gate
mods.description: Pre-PR gate: rounds of adversarial Codex review (gstack /codex) and agent fixes, run locally before a PR to dev or main is opened, with a live progress pane.

mods.name: toolscout
mods.description: Compacts the deferred tool list into one line per MCP server and, on every message, suggests the relevant tool groups, chosen by TypeSafe's Jev model.

mods.name: narrator
mods.description: Claude talks to you while it works: spoken narration in a browser page, and a voice side chat that answers questions and passes instructions without interrupting the task

mods.name: self-clear
mods.description: For long, unattended agent runs: when the conversation reaches a size you set, Claude writes a progress note, the mod checks it and clears the conversation, and (with auto-resume on) Claude carries on, so each step costs less. Off until a project turns it on.

mods.name: chime
mods.description: Three short sounds: a ding when a long turn finishes, a buzz when a tool errors, a chirp when Claude is waiting on a question.

mods.name: context-gauge
mods.description: A colored context-window gauge and running cost above the prompt, with a warning toast before compaction sneaks up on you.

mods.name: file-heat
mods.description: A pane ranking the files this session keeps touching: reads and writes per file as a heat bar, hottest first.

mods.name: git-pulse
mods.description: Branch, staged, modified, untracked and ahead/behind counts above the prompt, refreshed after every edit or shell command.

mods.name: pomodoro
mods.description: Focus timer in the band above the prompt: a progress bar, a countdown in the status line, a chime-free nudge when the block ends.

mods.name: rubber-duck
mods.description: A side pane that only asks questions. Explain your problem to the duck; it answers with three pointed questions and never a solution, without touching the main conversation.

mods.name: scratchpad
mods.description: A notes pane that survives sessions: jot a thought without sending it, pull it into the prompt later with one press.

mods.name: seatbelt
mods.description: Refuses the handful of commands nobody meant: rm -rf on root or home, force pushes, disk writes, DROP TABLE, and edits to secrets files.

mods.name: snippets
mods.description: Named text snippets that expand inside your prompt: type ;;review anywhere and it becomes your saved review checklist before the model sees it.

mods.name: timeline
mods.description: A pane that draws every turn as a strip of colored blocks, one per tool call: reads blue, edits orange, shell green, agents purple, errors red.

mods.name: flowmap
mods.description: Sidebar of live agents (with models) and an architecture map of the files Claude plans, edits and links

mods.name: commit-nag
mods.description: A band above the prompt that shows your branch, uncommitted files and time since your last commit, and roasts you when they pile up.

mods.name: bead-pane
mods.description: Click a beads issue ID in Claude's replies to open the bead in a side pane: status, children, blockers, notes

mods.name: collapse-answers
mods.description: Adds a button under each answer that collapses it, leaving only your question.

mods.name: prompt-highlight
mods.description: Highlights your prompts in the transcript with a background color.

mods.name: usage-status
mods.description: Shows the 5-hour and weekly usage limits in the status line.

mods.name: fix-bash-diffs
mods.description: Shows the first 8 lines of each file a Bash command changed, instead of 40

mods.name: session-status
mods.description: A native Claude Code status line and side pane: model, effort, context, quotas with burn-rate projection, cost and repo.

mods.name: superpowers-statusbar
mods.description: Live progress of a superpowers run: a band above the prompt, a side pane and notifications.

mods.name: chat-status
mods.description: A status line under the prompt for the chat on screen: model and effort pickers and an enhance button (locked while Claude or a subagent works), tokens or session cost, the folder, and a context pie.

mods.name: worktime
mods.description: Tracks effective work time per conversation (only while Claude is working, minus waits on you), with a side pane, /worktime commands, and tools Claude can use to log time to timesheets like ClickUp.

mods.name: podium
mods.description: Global working rules, software standards, operating modes, role agents and gate scripts under one namespace: /podium:<name>. Installed from the podium-marketplace (this repository's prod branch).

mods.name: agent-governor
mods.description: Watches subagents in long, fan-out-heavy sessions: a [GOV] band while agents run (count, peak, tokens) and a toast when too many run at once or an agent or the session goes over its token budget. Warn-only by default; /governor caps on asks before over-limit spawns and stops over-budget agents, /go…

mods.name: auto-model
mods.description: Picks the model per prompt with local rules: quick questions to Haiku, writing and explaining to Sonnet, building and fixing to Opus. The whole conversation always goes along; it switches only when the other model's prompt-cache re-read costs little.

mods.name: blast-radius
mods.description: Holds risky shell commands (rm -rf, git reset --hard, git clean, force push, migrations) and shows what they would change, with Proceed and Cancel buttons.

mods.name: chat-bubbles
mods.description: Messenger-style chat for Claude Code: your prompts on the right in a rival color, Claude on the left, only running or failing tools stand out. 441 themes. (Vendored from github.com/angeldelbiondo/claude-chat-bubbles @ 5597448, MIT. Modified for my-claude-mods: the footer keeps the row beneath, so p…

mods.name: checkpoint
mods.description: At every compaction, saves a handoff note (goal, open tasks, files, recent errors) to .claude/handoff/ and asks the summary to keep those facts; a later fresh session offers to resume from it (only a note this mod wrote, unchanged since). /handoff saves one now. No model calls.

mods.name: filetree
mods.description: An IDE-style file tree for Claude Code that shows what Claude is doing and where in files

mods.name: flightdeck
mods.description: Flightdeck: a live agent dashboard for Claude Code. Main model vitals, an on-call architect, every permission check, subagent cards and swimlanes, a turn receipt and a session log, all from real session events

mods.name: git-changes
mods.description: /changes pane: branch, ahead/behind, staged, unstaged, untracked and conflicted files with +/- line counts, recent commits. Read-only git, refreshed as Claude works.

mods.name: hw-write-guard
mods.description: Asks before Claude runs or writes code that drives hardware: nidaqmx DO/AO writes, pymodbus coil/register writes, pyserial writes, MQTT publishes to printer topics.

mods.name: mission-control
mods.description: Mission-control skin: [SYS]/[TOOL]/[EDIT] tool rows with per-tool icons and one status block above the prompt (under flightdeck's session log while its pane is open): [SYS] repo, branch, model, hw-guard; [CTL] model and effort buttons; [CTX] context fill with a /ctx pane by tool. /clean for a check…

mods.name: next-steps
mods.description: At the end of a turn Claude offers 2-4 follow-ups as buttons above the prompt, each showing the whole prompt it sends; a click sends that one. Gone as soon as you type something else.

mods.name: plan-progress
mods.description: Live plan progress bars above the Claude Code prompt: stages, steps, a pixel fill and soft sounds for decision, error and done

mods.name: prompt-upgrade
mods.description: /improve <prompt>: a pane asks 2-4 clickable questions about what you want, then writes a fuller prompt you can run, edit or copy. Two small model calls per upgrade, only when you ask.

mods.name: qa-jump
mods.description: /qa pane: every question you asked this session with the start of Claude's answer; click to jump the transcript to the answer or the question.

mods.name: redact
mods.description: Redacts secrets and PII from every row Claude Code stores and from the CLAUDE.md and memory context, before the model reads it and before the transcript keeps it. Restores a value only into a file that already holds it. No network, no processes, no file writes.

mods.name: reflect-lite
mods.description: When you correct Claude ("no", "don't", "I wish", "remember: ..."), a band offers to save it as a rule in CLAUDE.md or a skill. Local phrase matching, no model calls.

mods.name: replay-theater
mods.description: Replay Theater: step through the file edits Claude made in the last turn, one diff at a time. (Vendored from anthropic claude-code-playground @ 569c528, patched so its band row stacks above other mods' rows, and sits under flightdeck's session log while that pane is open.)

mods.name: retry-breaker
mods.description: Warns (never blocks) when Claude or a subagent keeps retrying the same failing command: a toast and a row above the prompt after 3 identical failures in a row.

mods.name: shared-edit-guard
mods.description: Asks before Claude edits a file that another tool (Gemini, an editor, another agent) changed in the last few minutes, through Edit/Write, a shell command that writes, or an MCP write tool. A Cancel keeps asking until you say Edit anyway or the change ages out.

mods.name: todays-report
mods.description: /report: tasks Claude finished today, this week, month or year, the time it worked, what the work was, which models did it, the API-equivalent cost, your streak, and an estimate of time saved at a rate you set. Counted locally, no model calls.

mods.name: manapool
mods.description: 5-hour and weekly limit bars, per-turn cost and hand-off advice, and a limit audit ledger, from local transcripts (costs no tokens).

mods.name: command-highlight
mods.description: Syntax-highlights Bash and PowerShell tool calls in the transcript, including scripts embedded in heredocs, here-strings and -c/-e strings, each in its own language.

mods.name: context-monitor
mods.description: Single-purpose Claude Code plugin that watches per-session context usage and warns the user before quality degrades.

mods.name: image-links
mods.description: The images Claude sends you or names in its answer, as chips above the prompt: hover one to see it, click to open it in Preview.

mods.name: account-switcher
mods.description: Save several Claude accounts and switch between them in one click, for the desktop app and the CLI

mods.name: status-line
mods.description: A status row above the prompt in the Desktop app: the session's context fill (amber at 200k, red at 250k), and the computer, git account and branch it runs on

mods.name: agent-theater
mods.description: A pixel theater above the prompt: little orange Claude acts out each tool call at a desk while a monitor shows the command and Haiku narrates it.

mods.name: file-browser
mods.description: 作業ディレクトリのファイルをペインに一覧し、文字のファイルは中で見て、ほかは既定のアプリで開く（/files）

mods.name: session-memo
mods.description: セッションごとのメモをメモ帳で書き、先頭の1行を入力欄の上に出す（/memo）

mods.name: epic-progress
mods.description: /epics: a live pane of Jira epic progress across teams, with an AI program summary

mods.name: wip-board
mods.description: /wip: a live pane of Jira work in progress by status, with WIP limits, aging and waiting items

mods.name: memory-reminders
mods.description: Shows a band above the prompt for `remind: YYYY-MM-DD text` lines in Claude memory notes that are due.

mods.name: native-edits
mods.description: Refuses file edits through Bash (sed -i, > file, tee, python open 'w') until Edit/Write has failed twice on that file.

mods.name: no-ai-trailer
mods.description: Git guards: blocks commits with an AI co-author trailer or a non-Conventional-Commits subject, force pushes, and secret files or keys headed into history.

mods.name: readme-keeper
mods.description: After a commit, asks Claude to update a README.md that is 5+ commits stale and a GitHub page with no description, no topics or a tag 5+ commits old; lints READMEs against standard-readme after each edit.

mods.name: repo-context
mods.description: Status line with git branch, session cost and context use; a git pane (/git) with branch switch, pull, push, fetch, file diffs, open PRs with CI and review state, and linked commits; a band when the session is not in a git repo.

mods.name: usage-meter
mods.description: Usage pane (/meter): cost, tokens and cache savings by day, week, month, year and all time from your transcripts; /keepwarm pings the prompt cache before it lapses while you are idle.

mods.name: voice-check
mods.description: Refuses outgoing emails, chat messages and gh PR/issue text that use words from the AI-writing blacklist, once; the same text sent again goes through.

mods.name: theme-watcher
mods.description: Follows ~/.claude/theme (written by ~/bin/scheme) and applies it as the Claude Code theme

mods.name: attention-is-all-i-need
mods.description: Colours what needs you at the end of Claude's replies (must-know, decide now, decide later, defaults, your actions) and pins open decisions above the prompt

mods.name: copy-code
mods.description: Frames each code block in Claude's replies in a box that names its language and has a copy button

mods.name: nerd-font
mods.description: Works out once whether a Nerd Font is installed, with a setting to force it on or off, so mods that draw Nerd Font glyphs know when to fall back

mods.name: vim-ux

mods.name: filetree
mods.description: An IDE-style file tree for Claude Code that shows what Claude is doing and where in files

mods.name: polish
mods.description: Cleans up dictated prompts with Haiku: drops the ums, false starts and spoken punctuation, and spells your jargon right. Learns your vocabulary as you type.

mods.name: skins
mods.description: Skins for Claude Code's transcript: themed tool rows, reply gutters and spinner words. /skin swaps them live.

mods.name: agent-board

mods.name: my-index

mods.name: context-guard
mods.description: Lets Claude check how full its context is, warns it past a share of the autocompact window, lets it compact the session at a stopping point and carry on, and counts the compactions, stopping Claude past a number of them without you.

mods.name: bash-rewrite
mods.description: Rewrites Bash commands that a PreToolUse guard would deny (heredoc or python -c containing backslashes, cd followed by relative file names) into an equivalent form before the guard sees them. Forms it cannot rewrite safely pass through unchanged and are still stopped by the guard.

mods.name: hook-daemon
mods.description: Answers heavy Python command hooks (PreToolUse / PostToolUse / Stop / UserPromptSubmit) from one resident process instead of spawning Python on every tool call. Falls back to the normal settings hooks whenever the resident process is unavailable.

mods.name: layer0-compose
mods.description: Moves the top-priority rule list (Layer 0) from per-turn UserPromptSubmit injection into the system prompt, where prompt caching applies. The injected copy is removed only when the system prompt really carries the same text.

mods.name: prompt-band
mods.description: Shows up to three hints above the prompt: tools that have been running for a while (elapsed time), what a one-key approval would approve when the last reply ends with a question, and a wrap-up hint based on context usage.

mods.name: secret-mask
mods.description: Redacts tokens, API keys and passwords from every row that enters the conversation (tool results, hook context, input, replies) before it is stored. The secret never reaches the model or the transcript.

mods.name: send-gate
mods.description: Before an outbound message is drafted, scheduled or sent (email draft script, chat post, chat MCP tools), checks that its full body was shown in the conversation and the user replied after seeing it. Blocks the call otherwise.

mods.name: shot-peek
mods.description: When Claude reads an image from the Screenshots folder, shows its file name and capture time above the prompt so you can confirm it read the screenshot you meant.

mods.name: usage-hud
mods.description: Three-box HUD above the prompt: tokens and API-equivalent cost across all sessions (daily and per-session breakdown), context-window meter with a soft limit, and prompt-cache warmth countdown with last-turn tokens and cost.

mods.name: prompt-rail
mods.description: Lists this conversation's prompts above the composer; one opens its question and answer.

mods.name: dev-up

mods.name: image-peek

mods.name: pr-proof

mods.name: lid-awake

mods.name: usage-footer

mods.name: conductor-mod

mods.description: Deixa o Claude ler o uso de contexto e os limites da conta, armar alarmes e agendar um /compact com instrucoes que retoma o trabalho sozinho

mods.name: notificar-espera
mods.description: Notificacao do Windows "claude is waiting: <nome-da-sessao>" quando o Claude termina o turno

mods.name: session-inbox
mods.description: Holds messages from other sessions in an /inbox pane instead of interrupting the turn, and adds working groups (sub-groups, communities of practice) in ~/.agents/groups.json that you and the model can post to

mods.name: shared-repo-guard
mods.description: Holds blanket git commands in the shared clones for the user's confirmation, with what they would touch; adds /lanes and a /prs pane of open pull requests in the repositories you list, and their CI.

mods.name: auto-pin
mods.description: Pins a new session in the desktop app's sidebar as it starts

mods.name: context-handoff
mods.description: Past a context threshold, records a hand-off and continues the work from the notes: in a new desktop-app session by default, or in this one after a compaction or the app's clear

mods.name: context-handoff-cli
mods.description: For the terminal: past a context threshold, records a hand-off, then starts a fresh session in the same terminal with /clear and continues the work from the notes

mods.name: context-meter
mods.description: Shows the git branch, context window usage, what the last turn added, and plan limit usage above the prompt

mods.name: session-end-unpin
mods.description: Unpins the session from the desktop app's sidebar once you ask to end it and Claude finds nothing left: the end-of-session steps done, no question, decision or follow-up waiting

mods.name: workhorse
mods.description: Hand coding, review and ops jobs to Codex as background subagents, with a live status band, watchdog warnings and completion notices

mods.name: 2fer
mods.description: A plugin that helps hold your spoken words in Claude Code to a human standard: a mark under each message you dictate opens a card scoring six speaking habits, with a session view and a weekly trend. It leaves out pastes, links and messages that read as typed.

mods.name: jump-list
mods.description: A side pane listing every prompt in the session: see where you are, click to jump back

mods.name: prompt-boost
mods.description: Put ++ at the start or end of a prompt to have it rewritten into a clear prompt for review before sending

mods.name: reply-tools
mods.description: Copy buttons on code blocks and a one-click tl;dr of long replies

mods.name: small-council
mods.description: A context-engineering council for Claude Code: tailored expert seats review, plan, build, and research in isolated context windows, debate the tough calls, verify adversarially, check finished work against your original request, fit the checks a project is missing, and report every build — shortcut…

mods.name: qodo-review-pane
mods.description: Unofficial Qodo review pane for Claude Code. Run a Qodo review of your working tree, browse findings, and draft a fix request for the one you pick. No automatic edits.

mods.name: all-prompts
mods.description: A side pane listing your prompts from every Claude Code session, newest first, with the session each was typed in

mods.name: prompt-jump
mods.description: option+k / option+j scroll the transcript to your previous / next prompt

mods.name: agent-monitor
mods.description: A sidebar pane for Claude Code: live progress, pause/resume, stop and messaging for subagents and workflow agents, plus session spend and plan limits

mods.name: profiles
mods.description: Several Claude Code logins over one shared setup: the current profile under the prompt, a /profile picker to switch, and commands to create, edit and delete profiles

mods.name: mr-inspector
mods.description: A band above the prompt that lists the MRs and PRs Claude created this session, each with a digit hotkey that opens it in the browser.

mods.name: activity
mods.description: A live crew panel: every agent, its model, effort, tokens and estimated cost, with a friendly pixel crab.

mods.name: copy-code-kb
mods.description: Copy a code block of the last reply from the keyboard: /cc [n], or a digit on the band above the prompt.

mods.name: chorus
mods.description: Browse a ship's chorus cabinet with /cabinet and sync trusted slips into project memory.

mods.name: switchboard
mods.description: One pane to turn every mod on or off, show or hide it, or open its side pane, in every chat. Finds new mods by itself.

mods.name: taxi-meter
mods.description: A taxi meter in the status line: the session's cost ticks up live as tokens burn.

mods.name: screen-peek
mods.description: Live panel of the screenshots Claude sees from Playwright, image reads, and any MCP tool

mods.name: coach-on-call
mods.description: "코치 <대충 쓴 말>"로 부를 때만 프롬프트를 다듬어 준다. 다듬은 걸 보낼지, 내 말 그대로 보낼지, 고쳐서 보낼지 고른다.

mods.name: hq-usage
mods.description: Claude 사용량 한도(5시간·주간)를 ~/.claude/board/usage.json에 남겨 Claude Session HQ 머리에 보이게 한다

mods.name: next-steps-multi
mods.description: 답이 끝나면 다음 프롬프트를 최대 3개 제안한다. 1·2·3으로 여러 개를 체크하고 0으로 한꺼번에 입력창에 넣는다.

mods.name: pinboard
mods.description: Keeps open decisions, the task list and links Claude creates in a sidebar pane, updated through its own tool. sirkitree/pinboard 0.1.0 을 고쳐 패널을 45칸으로 열고, 다시 띄운 세션은 대화 기록의 마지막 보드로 되살리고, 기억할 결정만 꽂게 한다.

mods.name: sparkle-progress
mods.description: Restyles the Simple Progress Bars band: a colored pill with a sparkly track, percent and a hopping pixel mascot. Agent cards draw anime characters by model: Opus as Naruto, Sonnet as Demon Slayer, Haiku as One Piece.

mods.name: context-bar
mods.description: Live context-window usage above the VS Code chat input, drawn from the plugin status line

mods.name: codebuddy
mods.description: 读取本机 CodeBuddy 登录信息，在底部状态区域显示剩余积分、总积分和今日用量

mods.name: shell-mode
mods.description: 用 /shell-mode 切换 Bash 模式，连续执行命令并显示颜色，退出后将输出保留在 CLI 中

mods.name: show-mode
mods.description: hidden 模式仅展示当前思考，回合结束清理临时显示，并保存文件 diff 与思考过程供回看；显式指定 off/hidden 切换

mods.name: agent-panel
mods.description: コンテキスト使用率・残りの使用量・使ったスキル・サブエージェントを表示するパネルと、入力欄上のバー

mods.name: cache-keeper
mods.description: Band trên ô nhập: cache, chi phí phiên, vòng quota 5h/tuần kèm giờ reset, gợi ý, nút cột dọc, thẻ You Should Know đẹp; dưới ô nhập: thanh token màu, nút Nén và dấu tích tự nén khi cache còn 5 phút

mods.name: usage-counter
mods.description: Keeps your 5-hour and weekly usage, reset countdowns and context fill on the status line.

mods.name: word-tutor
mods.description: Ask about unfamiliar coding terms in a side pane, without adding to the main conversation's context

mods.name: secret-guard
mods.description: Keeps API keys, tokens and passwords out of the transcript, tool output, files, commits, PRs and issues.

mods.name: prompt-master
mods.description: Polishes your rough prompt before Claude reads it: asks what's missing, then rewrites it with a clear prompt framework. One-click on/off button above the prompt box.

mods.name: lifetime-usage-dashboard
mods.description: A usage dashboard at the top of each new session: all-time (available history), last-7-days and today token totals, top model, busiest day, top tool, this session's tokens and context left. Counted from the Claude Code transcripts on this computer.

mods.name: clawd
mods.description: Clawd, Claude Code's pixel crab, walks above your prompt while Claude works. Click it to crack the whip.

mods.name: clawd-radio
mods.description: A one-row radio above your prompt with 54 stations, including Singapore's, played in the terminal.

mods.name: baton
mods.description: Context budget guard and handoff relay: measures real context use per model request, stops subagents that run too long or too big, and hands work over to a fresh session before the main agent drowns.

mods.name: mod-switch
mods.description: A mods button in the prompt footer opens a popover of every installed mod with switches that enable or disable them at user scope.

mods.name: relay
mods.description: Role buttons above the prompt: check or adversarially review the working tree with Codex, hand a task over to Codex, or verify with a second Claude model. A pane streams the run and turns findings into fix prompts.

mods.name: usage-feed
mods.description: Sends your Claude Code plan usage and each session's state to devTopBars, over a socket on your Mac.

mods.name: linear-tasks
mods.description: A side panel of your Linear cycle, what needs you, and your work queue, with buttons for Claude to plan and implement each issue

mods.name: cache-statusband
mods.description: Nate Herk's Cache Keeper plus a ccstatusline-style status band: model, effort, context, cache, 5-hour/weekly/Fable usage with resets, and reopened chats measured before you send

mods.name: seats
mods.description: /seats shows Claude rotator seat status without a model turn

mods.name: better-btw
mods.description: Replaces /btw with a side-question pane you can keep asking follow-ups in

mods.name: better-rewind
mods.description: Rewind or summarize from any prompt, tool call or AskUserQuestion answer, with a reply preview and saved branches

mods.name: dictation-cleaner
mods.description: Strips filler words, stutters and your usual typos from dictated prompts before Claude reads them.

mods.name: gearbox
mods.description: Model and effort presets as one row of chips above the prompt, set to your own taste, with a nudge toward a lighter preset for small tasks.

mods.name: limit-radar
mods.description: Your 5-hour, weekly and monthly usage in one pane, with a forecast of when you'll hit the 5-hour limit at your current pace and a heads-up when that comes before the reset.

mods.name: ship-cockpit
mods.description: Guards production deploys and production data, shows branch, PR, CI and issues in a Desktop-styled pane, and keeps a live Fleet ticker of your other projects.

mods.name: tokentide
mods.description: Watch the token tide rise: a ring above the prompt, a Rings pane, a prompt-cache countdown and a heads-up before auto-compact.

mods.name: waypoints
mods.description: Pin the reply where a decision landed, then fork a new line of work from that point with a handoff written for you. A map pane shows your pins and forks.

mods.name: sesiones-activas
mods.description: Junta en una franja y un panel las sesiones en las que estás trabajando, ordenadas por lo que necesitan de ti

mods.name: session-status
mods.description: Shows the agent's busy time, turn count, tool calls, tokens, context fill and cost above the prompt.

mods.name: subagent-effort
mods.description: Run each subagent on any model (gpt-6, grok-4.7, ...) at any reasoning effort, through model and effort parameters on the Agent tool

mods.name: context-line
mods.description: One-line summary of the context window under the prompt: usage, window size and the top 5 categories.

mods.name: chat-roles
mods.description: Barre de couleur, étiquette et heure sur chaque message du flux : vous, Claude, autres sessions, Cantina de KoA, monitors.

mods.name: jev-compact
mods.description: Context compaction that prunes instead of summarising: rules drop exploration output and hook noise locally, Jev ranks the rest against a budget, a note says what was removed, and removed outputs are archived for the brain. Falls back to the built-in summary when it cannot do better.

mods.name: jev-compact-trigger
mods.description: Companion to jev-compact: watches context use after every turn and starts a compaction at the configured percentage. mods.name: clean-view
mods.description: A calm checklist above the prompt that hides tool rows, for people who are not technical.

mods.name: prompt-upgrade
mods.description: Turns a rough prompt into a clear one in a review pane before it is sent.

mods.name: playwright-claude-mod
mods.description: Playwright tests and results in a side panel

mods.name: usage-meter
mods.description: A band above the prompt: context used, plan limits used and left, and the next reset

mods.name: agent-map
mods.description: Adds /agent-map, a pane that draws this session's agents as a node map: who started whom, who messaged whom, and what each one is doing

mods.name: blast-radius
mods.description: Catches risky shell commands (rm -rf, git reset --hard, force push, ...) before they run, forces a permission prompt, and shows what they would touch in a side pane.

mods.name: changed-files
mods.description: A live sidebar of every file Claude touched this session, with +/- line counts.

mods.name: codebase-atlas
mods.description: Understand a codebase visually: a live architecture map that lights up as Claude reads and edits, a call graph explorer, the session's changes by layer with their impact, a decision timeline, and side-question explanations that never enter your conversation. /atlas

mods.name: crew
mods.description: Agents side pane: every subagent as a little pixel crew member with its model, effort, context, tokens, cost and time; running, completed and planned tasks with their dependencies. /crew

mods.name: diff-minimap

mods.name: fork-explorer
mods.description: Ask "what if..." in a side pane: a side question over the current session returns 2-3 alternative approaches side by side, without adding anything to your conversation.

mods.name: mission-control
mods.description: Live view of what Claude is executing: every tool call with its input, output and status, subagents in their own lanes, and a network-tab style timeline of durations. Observe-only.

mods.name: replay-theater
mods.description: Records every file edit Claude makes in a turn; /replay steps through the diffs one at a time in a docked pane.

mods.name: session-meter
mods.description: Status line meter: elapsed time, tool calls and files edited this session, plus a toast when a long turn finishes.

mods.name: usage-forecast
mods.description: A band above the prompt with your plan's 5-hour and weekly limits (how much is used, when each resets, and whether you are on pace to run out) plus a forecast for the context window. /forecast

mods.name: workbench
mods.description: One workspace for watching and understanding Claude's work: a one-line band above the prompt and a pane with Now, Changes (file diffstat, changed functions, highlighted diffs, replay), live Preview, Artifacts, Code Map and Usage. /wb

mods.name: decisioncritic
mods.description: Reviews Claude's observable decisions with a separate critic model and shows evidence-backed criticism cards you can accept, challenge, implement and verify.

mods.name: worktrace
mods.description: A persistent file tree and timeline of the files Claude reads, searches and changes, with summaries and exact diffs.

mods.name: highlight-words
mods.description: Claude の応答から Haiku が重要な語句と確認が必要な語句を選び、ピンクとオレンジで描く（Dracula の配色）

mods.name: run-cat
mods.description: Claude が考えている間、CLI のプロンプト下のヒント行で AA の猫が走る（端末だけで描く）

mods.name: token-weather
mods.description: コンテキストの使用状況を天気で、ターンごとの作業ログ（Haiku が 1 行にまとめる）を一覧で、右のペインに示す。カードを押すと内訳・残り時間・ログの時刻が開く。/nippo で今日の日報の下書きを作る

mods.name: prompt-cats
mods.description: Two pixel cats (bright golden and brown tabby) above the prompt: sitting while idle, walking in place while Claude works.

mods.name: cells
mods.description: Lets Claude make several edits and their check, or a language-server lookup or rename, in one step through the real tools; guidance on chaining, which a subagent's task carries too; and a short note when a step cost a model request of its own for nothing.

mods.name: delegate
mods.description: A hand_off tool: Claude gives a self-contained task to a cheaper worker model (Haiku for lookups and mechanical changes, Sonnet for build work) that stays warm between tasks, with where the change reaches from the language server, the diff and a check run by the tool as evidence, a review by the ma…

mods.description: Writing to a length in one draft and cuts, not rewrites. mods.name: eta
mods.description: Shows long-running and background jobs with a percentage and an estimated finish time, read live from their output.

mods.name: modpack
mods.description: The claude-mods modpack: statusline, smart-compact, delegate, cells, eta, seek and draft, installed together and built to work together, and route, an optional mod that needs an outside classifier, off until you turn it on.

mods.name: seek
mods.description: Has Claude look around your code in few, lean steps. mods.name: smart-compact
mods.description: Keeps an idle session's prompt cache warm, or compacts it just before it expires, whichever is cheaper, and says on the status line whether the next prompt is ready or cold.

mods.name: statusline
mods.description: One line under the prompt: the model and its effort, how full the context is, the plan's 5-hour and 7-day use with their resets, and what other mods put on it (smart-compact's ready or cold).

The duck reads the gauges: task progress and how long the work will take, pace, context, plan limits, checks and cost in one instrument panel, with a rubber duck as Master Caution. Zero model tokens by default, no network, no processes, nothing added to cont…

mods.name: translate-to-english
mods.description: Translates your prompts into English with Haiku before Opus or Fable reads them, and asks for replies in Chinese

mods.name: session-rail
mods.description: One session pane that other mods add cards to, with a button at the right of the prompt footer to open and close it.

mods.name: todo-stack
mods.description: Adds a todo card to the session pane that keeps every todo the model creates on one stack shared by every session, newest on top, so none is lost to compaction, a reload or a new session; the model reads and edits it through a todos tool.

mods.name: usage-rail
mods.description: Adds a usage card to the session pane: session limit, weekly limit and cloud session credit, as the app's usage card shows them.

mods.name: agent-monitor
mods.description: Pannello live degli agenti e delle sessioni di progetto: stato, modello, token, durata e turni, con allarme di soglia e azioni Transcript/Ferma/attach.

mods.name: auto-clear-context
mods.description: Vicino alle soglie di contesto (morbida, dura, margine di sicurezza) Claude salva lo stato in un handoff validato; la mod esegue /clear e fa ripartire il lavoro nella sessione pulita.

mods.name: prompt-builder
mods.description: Prima che un prompt lungo arrivi alla sessione, lo trasforma in un brief chiaro con intervista e proposte approvate; ottimizza i consumi.

mods.name: next-steps
mods.description: After each turn, up to three suggested next prompts as buttons above the prompt: press one to send it, or dismiss (/next on|off)

mods.name: bichinho
mods.description: Bichinho ASCII acima do prompt que come os arquivos que o Claude lê, edita ou cria (/bichinho on|off)

mods.name: clima-contexto
mods.description: Clima do contexto: faixa acima do prompt com o quanto do contexto já foi usado (limpo, nublado, chuva, tempestade), limites 5h/semana, custo equivalente e botões de compactar e handoff (/contexto, /handoff-agora)

mods.name: faixa-publicacao
mods.description: Faixa de publicação: depois de um git push que deu certo, avisa para onde foi e que o deploy (Vercel/Pages) é automático; alerta se o remoto não está na lista permitida

mods.name: freio-de-mao
mods.description: Freio de mão: antes de um comando que apaga ou descarta (rm -rf, git reset --hard, git clean, push --force, pkill -f...), mede o estrago sem apagar e pergunta: prosseguir, lixeira, backup ou cancelar (/freio)

mods.name: guarda-colisao
mods.description: Guarda de colisão: antes de editar, avisa se o arquivo foi mudado fora desta sessão (outra sessão, você no editor, outro programa) e pergunta o que fazer (/colisao)

mods.name: linha-do-tempo
mods.description: Linha do tempo da sessão: turno a turno, modelo, esforço, ferramentas usadas, tokens e duração num painel (/timeline, /timeline exportar, /timeline limpar)

mods.name: mapa-calor
mods.description: Mapa de calor das pastas do projeto: quantos arquivos e quanto espaço cada pasta ocupa, com barra colorida (/mapa, /mapa bytes)

mods.name: marcador-sessao
mods.description: Marcadores de sessão: guarda um ponto da conversa com nome e resumo, e cola o resumo no prompt para retomar (/marcar <nome>, /marcar abrir, /marcar apagar <nome>)

mods.name: modo-gravacao
mods.description: Modo gravação para lives e vídeos: mascara na tela e-mails, tokens, IPs, telefones, CPF/CNPJ, valores e a pasta do usuário (/gravar on|off). Reduz o risco, não garante.

mods.name: painel-longrun
mods.description: Painel da execução longa: objetivo, tempo decorrido, checklist com % e as últimas linhas do progresso e do canal, atualizado sozinho (/longrun, /longrun todas)

mods.name: proximos-passos
mods.description: Próximos passos: quando a resposta termina com uma lista curta de opções, mostra até 3 botões acima do prompt que já escrevem o pedido (/proximos). Não chama o modelo: só lê o texto

mods.name: recibo-sessao
mods.description: Recibo da sessão: lista o que o Claude criou ou alterou, com botão para abrir a pasta (/recibo, /recibo ultimo, /recibo limpar)

mods.name: registrar-falha
mods.description: Quando comandos falham no turno, mostra botão que escreve no prompt o pedido de registrar a falha no FALHAS.md (/falha)

mods.name: replay-edicoes
mods.description: Replay das edições da sessão: passo a passo, cada Edit/Write com o diff, botões anterior/próximo e copiar (/replay)

mods.name: roteador-subagente
mods.description: Roteador de subagente: escolhe o modelo de cada subagente (Explore no haiku, general-purpose no sonnet...) sem mexer em modelo pedido explicitamente (/router on|off|sonnet|haiku|opus|status)

mods.name: tema-inema
mods.description: Identidade visual para lives: faixa 'INEMA.CLUB · projeto · hora' acima do prompt e destaque na cor da marca nas respostas (/tema on|off)

mods.name: tradutor-acoes
mods.description: Mostra em português simples o que o Claude está fazendo (lendo, editando, rodando comando...), mantendo o comando real logo abaixo (/tradutor on|off)

mods.name: vigia-api
mods.description: Vigia de API paga: pergunta antes de ferramentas e comandos que gastam dinheiro ou créditos (Magnific, Kling, HeyGen, OpenRouter, Groq...), com autorização por 1 hora (/vigia, /vigia limpar)

mods.name: done-alert

mods.name: witness
mods.description: Keeps a ledger of what you asked for and counts it done only on evidence: claims stay pale until a read-back confirms them, bare SQL UPDATE or DELETE writes are held for your answer, and a print of what was and was not witnessed goes into the session log.

mods.name: session-stats
mods.description: A band above the prompt with this session's token, cache, cost, context and rate-limit usage

mods.name: tool-call-counter

mods.name: auto-model

mods.name: maiyu
mods.description: Ai-chan, a pixel-art coding companion who celebrates wins, cheers you through losses, and shows the diffs

mods.name: composer-meter

mods.name: away-keep-running

mods.name: bg-task-band
mods.description: A band above the prompt showing running background tasks, their elapsed time and last output line

mods.name: command-guard
mods.description: Refuses shell commands a project's .claude/command-guards.json rules out, for the main loop and every subagent

mods.name: handoff-on-clear

mods.name: carousel-ship

mods.name: file-tree

mods.description: Your Linear issues and projects in a pane: read, change status, copy the branch, make a worktree, start in a Claude Code cloud session

mods.name: dont-yell-at-claude
mods.description: Rewrites your prompt before Claude sees it: case-insensitive find/replace rules from ~/.dont-yell.json.b64, with optional notices by replacement count, or block the prompt outright.

mods.name: session-kit
mods.description: A panel to choose which plugins, skills and MCP servers load: for one session, one project or all projects

mods.name: session-limits
mods.description: Estimates how much of the 5-hour and weekly plan limits this session uses, splitting the account meter across parallel sessions by their cost

mods.name: ctx-footer
mods.description: 바닥줄 SessionMode 자리에 컨텍스트 사용량 라벨을 더하는 미니멀 mod

mods.name: deltaplan
mods.description: Comment on Claude's plan line by line. See what changed as a diff.

mods.name: issue-tracker
mods.description: A pane beside the transcript with the GitHub issues of the project the session works in

mods.name: pulse-blast-radius
mods.description: Holds risky shell commands (rm -rf, git reset --hard, git clean, force push, migrations) and shows what they would change, with Proceed and Cancel buttons.

mods.name: pulse-cache-tax
mods.description: Keeps the one-hour prompt cache warm during /keepwarm windows and holds a cold send once with its estimated rewrite cost. Pinging runs only after /keepwarm. Fork of karanb192/cache-tax.

mods.name: pulse-filetree
mods.description: An IDE-style file tree for Claude Code that shows what Claude is doing and where in files

mods.name: pulse-progress
mods.description: Cosmetic mod: a QueerPulse-coloured progress band above the prompt and a /pulse panel of subagents. It only watches; it adds no tools and changes no prompts.

mods.name: pulse-reflect
mods.description: claude-reflect as a Claude Code mod: a model check on each short prompt finds reusable corrections (any language); a band above the prompt saves them to CLAUDE.md on one press

mods.name: omni-token
mods.description: Context window weather, tok/s, prompt-cache hit rate and TTL, and cache auto-warm, in the band above the prompt

mods.name: ctx
mods.description: Шкалы контекста, лимитов 5 ч и недели и таймер кэша под полем ввода

mods.name: handoff
mods.description: Передатчик: на 50% контекста одной кнопкой передаёт работу в чистый контекст — Claude пишет документ передачи, мод очищает контекст и продолжает работу по документу в том же окне. Копия мода Никиты Велса, порог 50% вместо 60%

mods.name: plan-progress
mods.description: Прогресс по плану: над полем ввода — план, который этот разговор открывал или правил: сколько галочек закрыто и какой шаг следующий

mods.name: sidebar
mods.description: Toggleable sidebar: usage and rate limits, git status, quick prompts, slash commands, todos, subagents, MCP servers with token cost, tool activity and errors; collapsible sections and in-pane settings.

mods.name: style
mods.description: Restyles Claude Code's UI: prompt bubbles, reply cards, tool-call cards and rails, framed plugin bands, notices, mode badges, the prompt hint, question dialogs and the turn-time line; every site set in a /style pane and drawn in your theme's colors.

mods.name: threads
mods.description: Research threads: /branch into a new VS Code window with a scoped brief, /find threads from verbatim hooks, /threads tree, bookmarks, /connect pass

mods.name: session-status
mods.description: One row of status dots above the prompt, in Catppuccin (Latte on light, Macchiato on dark): on desktop the row is one SVG with a rounded capsule, a colored dot per segment and small progress bars; on the terminal, text dots and text bars. Work item (its Azure DevOps title on hover), a red lock whil…

mods.name: turn-notify
mods.description: Toast and sound when Claude finishes a turn or needs your input

mods.name: harness-useful-skills
mods.description: Claude Code engineering workflows, safety reviews, and local memory tools

mods.name: barra-uso
mods.description: Due righe colorate sotto il prompt: contesto, limiti 5h e settimanali con reset, modello, costo, durata, branch

mods.name: runner
mods.description: Claude Runner: a small endless-runner side pane that plays while Claude works. It opens when a turn starts, a run follows the session's state (working, waiting for a tool, thinking) and goes on until you stop: a quick answer does not end your game. /runner opens or closes it by hand.

mods.name: waitroom
mods.description: Turn-based games and calm scenes in a pane while Claude works. Zero model tokens. Needs function hooks (early access) and Claude Desktop 2.1.269+.

mods.name: terminal-tab-title
mods.description: Names the terminal tab your coding agent runs in from your first prompt: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI and opencode, across tmux, zellij, screen, herdr, WezTerm, kitty, Konsole, ConEmu, iTerm2, Terminal.app, Windows Terminal, Ghostty and more

mods.name: plan-progress
mods.description: Live plan progress bars above the Claude Code prompt: stages, steps, a pixel fill and soft sounds for decision, error and done

mods.name: plan-de-vol
mods.description: Panneau latéral « plan de vol » : logigramme de la session (prompts, étapes, pourquoi) dans le style cockpit de status-band

mods.name: status-band
mods.description: Cockpit spatial transparent au-dessus du prompt : étoiles animées, saut quantique pendant le travail, 11 instruments (vaisseau, nav + git, bouclier, carburant 5 h/7 j, chrono, systèmes, escadrille, crédits, soute, contrats, heure), compactage progressif puis pages selon la largeur

mods.name: faixa-de-terreno
mods.description: Band above the prompt with the git branch, the issue number taken from the branch name, dirty files and commits ahead of main; turns red when you edit main directly or work on a branch with no issue number.

mods.name: indicador-de-contexto
mods.description: Watches the chat's context size: shows it from 200k; at 250k asks the model to propose splitting the rest of the work at the next transition point if something big and separable is left; at 400k, to propose a focused /compact, a new chat or carrying on. Each warning fires once per level and resets…

mods.name: novo-chat-ou-aqui
mods.description: Gives the agent a propor_desvio tool: when an extra step shows up mid-task, it compares the token cost of doing it in this chat or in a new one and recommends, with a ready handoff text.

mods.name: pendencias
mods.description: A pane listing, per project, the chats that ended waiting on you (asking for an OK, a test or a decision), with how long ago and whether their cache is still warm; dismiss each one.

mods.name: telinha-mcp
mods.description: A pane that opens whenever the agent or a subagent calls an MCP tool, saying in plain words which MCP was called, what it was asked and whether it finished.

mods.name: diff-fold
mods.description: Shows one summary line per file instead of the diff under Edit, Write, NotebookEdit and file-changing Bash calls

mods.name: clean-view
mods.description: Hides tool calls, diffs and command output while Claude works, and shows one plain-English checklist above the prompt instead.

mods.name: prompt-highlight
mods.description: Draws each prompt you type in a sky-blue box with black text and a "You" label, so it stands apart from Claude's replies.

mods.name: chat-inbox
mods.description: An inbox pane for the Code chats in the Claude desktop app: unread chats, search across every chat, sorting by newest, oldest or most important

mods.name: dcp
mods.description: /prune: drop tool outputs from the context, all at once or picked from a list

mods.name: model-gear
mods.description: Automatically selects the right Claude Code model and reasoning effort for every prompt, balancing performance, speed, and cost.

mods.name: model-router
mods.description: Jev (TypeSafe) picks the model and effort per task type; ported from jev-model-router with main-loop model switching on

mods.name: guard-a
mods.description: 削除・巻き戻しの影響範囲ガード: rm -rf・git reset --hard・force push・find -delete・rsync --delete・sh -c/eval/ssh の入れ子・rollback スクリプトなどを静的に判定して保留し、確認ダイアログで実行するか止めるかを聞く。画面が無い時は理由つきで止める。

mods.name: progress-band
mods.description: タスク進捗（TaskCreate/TaskUpdate/TodoWrite/update_plan）と文脈使用量を、プロンプト上の帯 1 行で持続表示する。決定的コードのみ・fail-open。

mods.name: matrix
mods.description: Jack Claude Code into the Matrix: digital rain above the prompt, phosphor-green transcript, and messages from Zion.

mods.name: token-dashboard
mods.description: A live TUI pane showing this session's token usage, cost, context fill and rate limits

mods.name: machau-mod
mods.description: Machau's Claude mod: one small piece per recurring problem (secret mask, no blank Chrome, context trim, model routing; optional live-claim guard and no Claude in Chrome)

mods.name: cache-keepwarm
mods.description: Keeps the prompt cache of an idle Claude Code session warm: just before the cache lapses it submits a short service prompt, so your next message reads the context from the cache instead of writing it again. Off by default; /keepwarm on|off|status. Needs function hooks (early access).

mods.name: usage-bar
mods.description: A one-line usage bar above the prompt: 5-hour, weekly and per-model plan limits with reset countdowns, plus the session's tokens and cost.

mods.name: meme
mods.description: Troca as bolinhas de trabalho do Claude por gatinhos em pixel e pelos memes que você escolher, no app e no terminal.

mods.name: reply-ui
mods.description: Draws Claude's replies better in the terminal: Codex-style tables, a TLDR card, Pick options as key badges, and a gray band on your prompts

mods.name: senior-dev
mods.description: Gated, story-driven delivery: approved acceptance criteria and plan, then a blind reviewer and a blind tester until every criterion is proven

mods.name: sprint-pilot
mods.description: From the items assigned to you this sprint to ready chats: reads your tracker, checks stories for gaps, plans branches and order, and opens each unit as its own chat on its own branch

mods.name: aleph-zero
mods.description: Local code search for coding agents: ranked code locations by meaning or by name, always matching the working tree, and steering that makes Claude Code use it before recursive grep

mods.name: dev-tab
mods.description: Button that brings up the browser tab for this worktree's dev server

mods.name: rebase-button
mods.description: Band above the prompt when the branch is behind trunk, with a Rebase button

mods.name: test-grader
mods.description: A side pane that grades every test in the project (strong, shallow, brittle, hollow, duplicate), tells Claude how to write tests that grade strong, and shows coverage.

mods.name: context-bar
mods.description: Leiste über dem Eingabefeld: Prompt-Cache-Restzeit, Cache-Hit-Rate, Kontextfüllung mit Wetter und ein Compact-Button

mods.name: usage-bar
mods.description: Zeile über dem Eingabefeld: Plan-Verbrauch im 5-Stunden- und Wochenfenster mit Balken, Prozent und Reset-Zeit

mods.name: usage-meter
mods.description: Riga sopra il prompt con la % del limite settimanale (e 5h) dell'abbonamento e il tempo al reset

mods.name: tldr-checklist
mods.description: Teaches a TL;DR / → You reply format and keeps a side pane with the latest TL;DR, the session's goal, next step and blockers, and a persistent checklist of every → You line

mods.name: context-bar
mods.description: A context-window breakdown bar above the prompt, toggled with /context-bar

mods.name: done-sound
mods.description: Plays a macOS system sound when Claude finishes a turn

mods.name: mask-that-pass
mods.description: Masks credentials in tool output (URL passwords, *_TOKEN / *_SECRET / *_PASSWORD values, API keys, bearer tokens, private keys) before Claude or the transcript sees them. No network, files or processes.

mods.name: frontier-pacer
mods.description: One line above the prompt: context tokens, session cost, active time, a prompt-cache countdown and your plan limits with pace

mods.name: tag-team
mods.description: Tag Team Wrestling: Your work and personal Claude accounts side by side: usage as fighting-game life bars, a retro match history of your token use, and one-click switching between them. Built on claude-swap.

mods.name: automatico
mods.description: Modo automático: encadena las tareas del plan, cada una en una ventana nueva con su modelo, hasta un tope de uso. Botón sobre el prompt para prenderlo/apagarlo

mods.name: harness-nacho
mods.description: Reglas de trabajo de Nacho (con Perfil y Lecciones) + tablero al arrancar (tareas, git, uso, pruebas, errores de la app, novedades para Claude Code) + scripts sin LLM (buscar_novedades, medir_tokens) + skills (tarea, cerrar-tarea, planificar, proyecto-nuevo, cierre-charla, podar, plugins-proyecto,…

mods.name: semaforo
mods.description: Circulo al costado del chat: rojo mientras Claude trabaja o hay tareas de fondo, verde cuando no queda nada

mods.name: uso-widget
mods.description: Barra fija sobre el prompt con el uso del plan: ventana de 5 h (sesión) y semanal, con aviso al 80/90%.

mods.name: connect-four
mods.description: Play Connect Four against an AI in a Claude Code pane: /connect-four

mods.name: match-3
mods.description: Match-3 puzzle game in a Claude Code pane: /match3 – 5 colors, 5 levels, rockets, bombs, prisms and combos

mods.name: prompt-master
mods.description: /w <prompt> rewrites a rough prompt into a clearer one and puts it back in the prompt box to review and send

mods.name: token-distribution
mods.description: A pane showing the session's tokens by kind (input, output, cache read, cache write 5m and 1h) and how long each cache tier stays warm

mods.name: brain-dump
mods.description: Turns a long, rambling voice dump into a clear, structured prompt before it is sent. Asks short multiple-choice questions about real gaps first, then puts the result in your prompt box to check.

mods.name: cache-clock
mods.description: A countdown above the prompt that shows when the chat's prompt cache goes cold, what that would cost, and an opt-in, capped Keep warm button. Offers a handoff to a fresh chat when a big chat goes cold.

mods.name: chat-inventory
mods.description: A side pane, In this chat, that lists the to-do list, the connectors used (with a call count and a tool breakdown for each), the files read or changed, and the skills this chat used.

mods.name: handoff
mods.description: When a chat gets very long, writes a handoff of the whole chat (what was asked, what is done, files to open, next steps), shows the steps with progress bars, then copies it or starts a fresh chat with it. Works at a token limit you choose, or any time with /handoff.

mods.name: helper-desk
mods.description: A side pane that shows Claude working: a live card for this chat (what it is doing right now), a card for every helper (subagent) with its result, and a short Recent list. Plus a purple task bar above the prompt that fills as Claude ticks off its to-do list and says what is running.

mods.name: mods
mods.description: The switchboard for your mods. /mods opens a pane that finds every mod on this Mac (your folders, marketplaces, this chat's own), turns each one on or off in every chat, hides or shows it, and opens the side-pane ones.

mods.name: reflect
mods.description: When you correct Claude, offers to save the fix as a lasting rule: in your global CLAUDE.md, in the project's CLAUDE.md, or as a note in a rules folder. Nothing is written until you press a button, you see the exact text first, and every save can be undone.

mods.name: replay-theater
mods.description: Replay Theater: step through the file edits Claude made, one diff at a time. Any of the last turns, with real line numbers, side by side or unified, a file list, a filter, a patch to copy, and folded diffs for minified and generated files.

mods.name: screen-share
mods.description: /screen-share hides emails, phone numbers, money amounts, names, keys and card numbers on screen while you record. Only the drawing changes: Claude and the chat still hold the real data. If hiding a row fails, the row is drawn as a bar, never as raw text.

mods.name: mods-pdf
mods.description: Build Japanese and English PDFs inside a Claude Code Mod, with no external programs: documents, landscape decks, business plans, 56 chart shapes, ruby, kinsoku, form fields, fill and merge. Frozen.

mods.name: imgdec
mods.description: Reduces images attached to a prompt (trim margins, downscale) before the model reads them. macOS and Linux.

mods.name: lime
mods.description: 会話をチャットの吹き出し風の HTML にして、cmux の横に開く（/lime [セッションID]）。会話が進むと自動で更新する。/lime-codex on で、同じ作業フォルダの Codex のやりとりを Claude に渡せる

mods.name: grass-tracker
mods.description: GitHub-style contribution grid of your Claude Code token usage: a 24-hour bar above the prompt and /grass for the calendar and weekday × hour heatmap

mods.name: context-bars
mods.description: Pane that draws the session's context window as a bar chart, one bar per category
